```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# =============================================================================
# STAGE 0. SETUP
# Packages, params, constants, palettes, the focus table, helpers, input check.
# =============================================================================
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 9, fig.height = 6)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(readr); library(stringr)
  library(purrr); library(tibble); library(ggplot2); library(lubridate)
  library(sf); library(knitr); library(kableExtra); library(scales)
  library(tidycensus)
})
options(dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE, scipen = 999)

# Projections: all areas, overlays and point-in-polygon tests in
# EPSG:2229 (US survey feet); 3857 only to draw static maps on the basemap;
# 4326 only for web maps.
crs_ft  <- 2229
crs_web <- 4326
crs_map <- 3857

# Status palette and dated-bar palette
pal_status <- c("Completed" = "#0072B2", "In progress" = "#F0C808", "Stalled" = "#C0392B")
pal_dated  <- c("Completed" = "#0072B2", "New" = "#2A9D8F", "Ongoing" = "#F0C808")

# The six candidate CPAs in report order, with their region
focus <- tribble(
  ~region,               ~cpa,
  "San Fernando Valley", "Arleta - Pacoima",
  "South LA",            "West Adams - Baldwin Hills - Leimert",
  "South LA",            "South Los Angeles",
  "South LA",            "Southeast Los Angeles",
  "Eastside",            "Northeast Los Angeles",
  "Eastside",            "Boyle Heights")
focus_cpas <- focus$cpa

# CPAs exempt from the hillside-fire restriction by location, LAMC 12.22 A.33(c)(4)(i)
fire_exempt_cpas <- c("Northeast Los Angeles", "Silver Lake - Echo Park - Elysian Valley")

dir_derived <- "data/derived"   # small derived files, committed
dir_cache   <- "data/cache"     # large intermediate files, gitignored
dir.create(dir_derived, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(dir_cache,   recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ---- Helpers -----------------------------------------------------------------
fmt  <- function(x, d = 0) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = d, big.mark = ",")
pct  <- function(x, d = 1) paste0(formatC(100 * x, format = "f", digits = d), "%")
tbl  <- function(df, caption = NULL, note = NULL, ...) {
  k <- kable(df, format = "html", caption = caption, format.args = list(big.mark = ","), ...) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
  if (!is.null(note)) k <- footnote(k, general = note, general_title = "Note: ",
                                    footnote_as_chunk = TRUE, threeparttable = TRUE)
  k
}
as_num <- function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
mdy_   <- function(x) suppressWarnings(as.Date(lubridate::mdy(x)))

# QA log: every stage check is recorded here; checks marked stop_if_fail end the
# knit. Benchmarks from earlier computations are recorded without stopping
# and compared in stage 9.
qa <- tibble(stage = character(), check = character(), expected = character(),
             observed = character(), result = character(), reason = character())
qa_add <- function(stage, check, expected, observed, pass, stop_if_fail = FALSE, reason = NA_character_) {
  # result: "pass"; "explained" when a target is missed with a computed, logged
  # reason; "FAIL" otherwise. Stage 9 stops on any FAIL among benchmarks.
  res <- if (isTRUE(pass)) "pass" else if (!is.na(reason)) "explained" else "FAIL"
  qa <<- add_row(qa, stage = as.character(stage), check = check,
                 expected = as.character(expected), observed = as.character(observed),
                 result = res, reason = if (isTRUE(pass)) NA_character_ else reason)
  if (!isTRUE(pass) && stop_if_fail)
    stop(sprintf("Stage %s check failed: %s (expected %s; observed %s)",
                 stage, check, expected, observed), call. = FALSE)
  invisible(pass)
}

# ---- Basemap helpers, carried over from the earlier Rmd ----------------------
# Esri World Light Gray Canvas: base tiles plus the minimal reference labels.
# Tiles are cached in a gitignored tiles/ folder; white if the server is down.
lon2x <- function(lon, z) (lon + 180) / 360 * 2^z
lat2y <- function(lat, z) (1 - log(tan(lat*pi/180) + 1/cos(lat*pi/180))/pi) / 2 * 2^z
tile_src <- c(
  base = "https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/Canvas/World_Light_Gray_Base/MapServer/tile/%d/%d/%d",
  ref  = "https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/Canvas/World_Light_Gray_Reference/MapServer/tile/%d/%d/%d")
read_tile <- function(f) {   # base tiles are JPEG, the label overlay PNG
  magic <- readBin(f, "raw", 3)
  if (identical(magic, as.raw(c(0x89, 0x50, 0x4e)))) png::readPNG(f)
  else if (identical(magic[1:2], as.raw(c(0xff, 0xd8)))) jpeg::readJPEG(f)
  else stop("not an image")
}
light_basemap <- function(bb4326, zoom, cache_dir = "tiles") {
  dir.create(cache_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
  x0 <- floor(lon2x(bb4326[["xmin"]], zoom)); x1 <- floor(lon2x(bb4326[["xmax"]], zoom))
  y0 <- floor(lat2y(bb4326[["ymax"]], zoom)); y1 <- floor(lat2y(bb4326[["ymin"]], zoom))
  img <- array(1, dim = c(256*(y1-y0+1), 256*(x1-x0+1), 3))   # white fallback
  for (tx in x0:x1) for (ty in y0:y1) {
    tile <- NULL
    for (layer in names(tile_src)) {
      f <- file.path(cache_dir, sprintf("%s_%d_%d_%d.png", layer, zoom, tx, ty))
      if (!file.exists(f))   # Esri tile scheme is z/y/x
        try(download.file(sprintf(tile_src[[layer]], zoom, ty, tx),
                          f, mode = "wb", quiet = TRUE), silent = TRUE)
      if (file.exists(f) && file.size(f) > 0) {
        p <- try(read_tile(f), silent = TRUE)
        if (!inherits(p, "try-error")) {
          if (length(dim(p)) == 2) p <- array(rep(p, 3), dim = c(dim(p), 3))
          if (is.null(tile)) tile <- array(1, dim = c(dim(p)[1], dim(p)[2], 3))
          if (dim(p)[3] >= 4) {          # label overlay: alpha-composite
            a <- p[, , 4]
            for (ch in 1:3) tile[, , ch] <- p[, , ch]*a + tile[, , ch]*(1 - a)
          } else tile <- p[, , 1:3]
        }
      }
    }
    if (!is.null(tile))
      img[(ty-y0)*256 + 1:256, (tx-x0)*256 + 1:256, ] <- tile
  }
  R <- 6378137
  list(img = img,
       ext = c(xmin = (x0/2^zoom*2 - 1)*pi*R,     xmax = ((x1+1)/2^zoom*2 - 1)*pi*R,
               ymin = (1 - (y1+1)/2^zoom*2)*pi*R, ymax = (1 - y0/2^zoom*2)*pi*R))
}
basemap_layer <- function(bm, fade = 0) {   # fade: 0 = full basemap, 1 = white
  img <- if (fade > 0) bm$img * (1 - fade) + fade else bm$img
  annotation_raster(img, bm$ext[["xmin"]], bm$ext[["xmax"]],
                    bm$ext[["ymin"]], bm$ext[["ymax"]])
}
zoom_for <- function(bb4326, tiles = 4)
  min(15L, max(9L, floor(log2(360 * tiles / (bb4326[["xmax"]] - bb4326[["xmin"]])))))
basemap_credit <- "Basemap: Esri World Light Gray Canvas | Esri, HERE, Garmin, (c) OpenStreetMap contributors"

# ---- Which stages must run (caching) -----------------------------------------
# Stages 2, 3 and 5 write to data/derived/ and are skipped when params$refresh is
# FALSE and their files exist. Stage 4's output is the joined ADU project table,
# also a derived file, so it is cached with the same rule. Stage 1's crosswalk is
# always rebuilt (it is fast); its parcel tagging runs only when stage 2 runs.
f_crosswalk <- file.path(dir_derived, "tract_cpa_crosswalk.csv")
f_parcels   <- file.path(dir_derived, "parcel_class_citywide.rds")
f_prop_six  <- file.path(dir_derived, "prop_six_cpas.rds")
f_projects  <- file.path(dir_derived, "adu_projects_stage3.rds")
f_joined    <- file.path(dir_derived, "adu_projects_joined.rds")
f_acs       <- file.path(dir_derived, "acs_tract.csv")
f_acs_extra <- file.path(dir_derived, "acs_reference_values.csv")
f_geo_cache <- file.path(dir_cache, "parcel_geo.rds")

run2 <- params$refresh || !all(file.exists(c(f_parcels, f_prop_six)))
run3 <- params$refresh || !file.exists(f_projects)
run4 <- params$refresh || run2 || run3 || !file.exists(f_joined)
run5 <- params$refresh || !all(file.exists(c(f_acs, f_acs_extra)))

# ---- Input check: stop if an input this knit needs is missing ----------------
need <- c(params$path_cpa, params$path_tracts, params$path_hillside, params$path_fire)
if (run2) need <- c(need, params$path_roll,
                    if (!file.exists(params$path_parcel_shp) &&
                        !(file.exists(f_geo_cache) && !params$refresh)) params$path_parcel_zip)
if (run3) need <- c(need, params$path_permits_2010s, params$path_permits_2020s)
if (run4) need <- c(need, params$path_city_parcels)
missing_inputs <- need[!file.exists(need)]
qa_add(0, "Input paths this knit needs exist", "none missing",
       if (length(missing_inputs)) paste(missing_inputs, collapse = "; ") else "none missing",
       length(missing_inputs) == 0, stop_if_fail = TRUE)
# ---- Dates shown in the definitions box, before stage 3 runs -----------------
# extract_date: the download date in the permit file names. asof_early: the
# latest STATUS_DATE in the extracts (stage 3 checks it against its own value).
fmt_date <- function(d) str_squish(format(d, "%B %e, %Y"))
extract_date <- as.Date(str_extract(basename(params$path_permits_2020s), "\\d{8}(?=\\.csv$)"), "%Y%m%d")
asof_early <- if (!run3) readRDS(f_projects)$data_asof else {
  last_status <- function(p) max(mdy_(read_csv(p, col_select = "STATUS_DATE", col_types = cols(.default = col_character()),
                                               progress = FALSE)$STATUS_DATE), na.rm = TRUE)
  max(last_status(params$path_permits_2010s), last_status(params$path_permits_2020s))
}
if (run5) {
  if (file.exists(".Renviron")) readRenviron(".Renviron")
  qa_add(0, "CENSUS_API_KEY set (read from .Renviron, never printed)", "set",
         if (nzchar(Sys.getenv("CENSUS_API_KEY"))) "set" else "missing",
         nzchar(Sys.getenv("CENSUS_API_KEY")), stop_if_fail = TRUE)
}
```

This report compares six candidate Community Plan Areas (CPAs) in three regions of the City of Los Angeles: **Arleta - Pacoima** in the San Fernando Valley; **West Adams - Baldwin Hills - Leimert**, **South Los Angeles** and **Southeast Los Angeles** in South LA; and **Northeast Los Angeles** and **Boyle Heights** on the Eastside. Each CPA gets a land use section, an ADU section and a community demographics section, followed by a closing section that sets the candidates side by side.

<div class="alert alert-info">
**Definitions used throughout**

- **ADU project**: one permitted job. An ADU job often has several permit records: the original building permit and any supplemental permits filed later to revise it. Together these are the project's **permit chain**, and each chain is counted once.
- **ADU unit**: one ADU or junior ADU that the project adds. Most projects add one unit; status tables, charts and maps count units.
- **Statuses** (exclusive of each other): **Completed** (a certificate of occupancy, a final inspection or a certificate of completion anywhere in the permit chain); **Stalled** (not completed, and no change in permit status for three years or more, counted back from the latest status date in the data: the last status change was on or before `r fmt_date(asof_early %m-% years(3))`); **In progress** (everything else still active: not completed, with a status change after `r fmt_date(asof_early %m-% years(3))`).
- **Parcel-level ADU Eligibility Tiers** (Internal definitions): **tier A** counts single-family and multi-family lots of 4,500 sq ft or more; **tier B** also removes lots that lie in both a Very High Fire Hazard Severity Zone and a Hillside Area. Lots in the 1) Northeast Los Angeles and 2) Silver Lake - Echo Park - Elysian Valley CPAs are exempt from this restriction ([LAMC 12.22 A.33(c)(4)](https://cityclerk.lacity.org/onlinedocs/2016/16-1468_ord_draft_12-05-2019.pdf), Ordinance No. 186,481, effective December 19, 2019; [Council File 16-1468-S2](https://cityclerk.lacity.org/onlinedocs/2016/16-1468-S2_misc_4-26-24.pdf)), so tier B removes no lots there. Notably, lots excluded through tier B may still have ADUs, given that the City's ADU ordinance allows an ADU if it has an automatic fire sprinkler system, one off-street parking space and frontage on a street with at least 20 feet of improved roadway.
- **Data dates**: ADU permits issued from January 1, 2017 through `r fmt_date(asof_early)`, the latest status date in the LADBS extracts (downloaded `r fmt_date(extract_date)`); the 2026 Assessor roll; the 2020–2024 American Community Survey.
</div>

## Geography: the tracts in each CPA

A census tract belongs to a CPA when **at least 50% of its land area** lies inside the CPA boundary. Tracts are the one exception to the interior-point rule used for every other polygon, because a tract's interior point can fall outside a CPA that holds most of the tract. Tracts carry ACS data and tract-level counts; parcels and ADUs are assigned to a CPA by their own location.

```{r stage1-geography}
# =============================================================================
# STAGE 1. GEOGRAPHY
# Reads CPAs, tracts and (when stage 2 runs) the County parcels. Computes CPA
# area, builds the tract-to-CPA crosswalk, and tags every parcel whose interior
# point falls in a CPA with cpa, ct20 and tract_cpa.
# Stops the knit if: tract counts differ from the expected lists, a tract maps to two
# CPAs, or a parcel has a CPA but no tract.
# =============================================================================
to_ft <- function(x) if (is.na(st_crs(x)$epsg) || st_crs(x)$epsg != crs_ft) st_transform(x, crs_ft) else x

cpa_sf <- st_read(params$path_cpa, quiet = TRUE) %>% st_make_valid() %>% to_ft() %>%
  mutate(cpa = NAME_ALF, area_sqft = as.numeric(st_area(geometry)))
qa_add(1, "All six candidate CPAs found in NAME_ALF", "6",
       sum(focus_cpas %in% cpa_sf$cpa), all(focus_cpas %in% cpa_sf$cpa), stop_if_fail = TRUE)

tracts_sf <- st_read(params$path_tracts, quiet = TRUE) %>% st_make_valid() %>% to_ft() %>%
  mutate(CT20 = str_pad(as.character(CT20), 6, pad = "0"),
         GEOID = paste0("06037", CT20),
         tract_area = as.numeric(st_area(geometry))) %>%
  select(CT20, GEOID, LABEL, tract_area)

# ---- Crosswalk -------------------------------------------------------------
six_sf <- cpa_sf %>% filter(cpa %in% focus_cpas) %>% select(cpa)
xw_all <- st_intersection(tracts_sf, six_sf) %>%
  mutate(int_area = as.numeric(st_area(geometry))) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(share_in_cpa = int_area / tract_area)
tract_xwalk <- xw_all %>%
  filter(share_in_cpa >= 0.5) %>%
  left_join(focus, by = "cpa") %>%
  arrange(match(cpa, focus_cpas), CT20) %>%
  select(CT20, GEOID, cpa, region, share_in_cpa, int_area, tract_area)
write_csv(select(tract_xwalk, CT20, GEOID, cpa, region, share_in_cpa), f_crosswalk)

# ---- Citywide tract assignment (citywide working-class map only) -------------
# A tract is in the City when at least 50% of its land lies inside the 35 CPAs;
# it is labeled with the CPA holding the largest share of its land.
city_xwalk <- st_intersection(tracts_sf, select(cpa_sf, cpa)) %>%
  mutate(int_area = as.numeric(st_area(geometry))) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(CT20, GEOID) %>%
  summarise(share_in_city = sum(int_area) / first(tract_area),
            cpa = cpa[which.max(int_area)], .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(share_in_city >= 0.5)

# ---- Checks against the expected tract lists ---------------------------------
expected_tracts <- list(
  "Arleta - Pacoima" = "104105 104108 104201 104203 104310 104321 104322 104401 104403 104404 104500 104610 104620 104701 104703 104704 104821 104822 104823 104824 109500 119003 119004 119201 119202 119400 119801 119802 980021",
  "West Adams - Baldwin Hills - Leimert" = "218110 218120 218210 218220 218300 218400 218500 218600 218701 218702 218800 218900 219010 219020 219300 219500 219700 219800 219901 219902 220000 220100 234001 234002 234200 234301 234302 234501 234502 234600 234700 234800 234901 234902 235100 235201 235202 236001 236101 236102 236203 236204 236205 236206 236400 269601 269602 269700 270200 270300",
  "South Los Angeles" = "221110 221120 221210 221220 221302 221303 221304 221401 221402 221500 221601 221602 221710 221810 221820 221900 222001 222002 222100 222200 222500 222600 222700 224410 224420 224701 224702 231210 231220 231301 231302 231400 231500 231601 231602 231603 231710 231720 232110 232120 232200 232300 232401 232402 232500 232601 232602 232701 232702 237101 237102 237201 237202 237300 237401 237402 237500 237600 237710 237720 237800 237900 238000 238100 238200 238310 238320 238400 240301 240302 240401 240402 241201 241202 241300",
  "Southeast Los Angeles" = "224020 224600 226001 226410 226420 226701 226702 227010 227020 228100 228210 228220 228310 228320 228410 228420 228500 228600 228710 228720 228800 228900 229100 229200 229300 229410 229420 231100 231800 231901 231902 232800 239201 239202 239310 239320 239330 239501 239502 239601 239602 239701 239702 239801 239802 240010 240020 240200 240500 240600 240700 240800 240901 240902 241001 241002 241110 241120 241400 242000 242100 242201 242202 242300 242600 242700 243001 243002 243100",
  "Northeast Los Angeles" = "181000 181300 181400 181500 181600 183101 183103 183104 183220 183221 183222 183300 183401 183402 183510 183520 183610 183620 183701 183702 183810 183820 185101 185102 185202 185203 185204 185310 185320 186100 186201 186202 186203 186301 186302 186401 186403 186404 187101 187102 188100 188300 199001 199002 199110 199120 199201 199202 199300 199400 199700 199801 199802 199900 201110 201120 201200 201301 201302 201401 201402 201501 201503 201504 201601 201602 201700 203100 203300",
  "Boyle Heights" = "203200 203500 203601 203602 203710 203720 203800 203900 204110 204120 204200 204300 204410 204420 204600 204700 204810 204820 204910 204920 205110 205120 206050 206053 206054") %>%
  map(~ strsplit(.x, " ")[[1]])
expected_n <- c(29, 50, 75, 69, 69, 25)
for (i in seq_along(focus_cpas)) {
  got <- sort(tract_xwalk$CT20[tract_xwalk$cpa == focus_cpas[i]])
  qa_add(1, paste0("Tract count, ", focus_cpas[i]), expected_n[i], length(got),
         length(got) == expected_n[i], stop_if_fail = TRUE)
  qa_add(1, paste0("Tract list matches the expected list, ", focus_cpas[i]), "identical",
         if (identical(got, sort(expected_tracts[[focus_cpas[i]]]))) "identical" else "differs",
         identical(got, sort(expected_tracts[[focus_cpas[i]]])), stop_if_fail = TRUE)
}
qa_add(1, "No tract maps to two CPAs", "0", sum(duplicated(tract_xwalk$CT20)),
       !any(duplicated(tract_xwalk$CT20)), stop_if_fail = TRUE)
xw_chk <- tract_xwalk %>% select(CT20, cpa) %>% left_join(select(city_xwalk, CT20, cpa_city = cpa), by = "CT20")
qa_add(1, "Citywide tract assignment keeps every six-CPA tract in its CPA", "317 of 317",
       paste(sum(xw_chk$cpa == xw_chk$cpa_city, na.rm = TRUE), "of", nrow(xw_chk)),
       all(xw_chk$cpa == xw_chk$cpa_city, na.rm = FALSE) && !any(is.na(xw_chk$cpa_city)), stop_if_fail = TRUE)

# CPA areas and tract coverage, recorded as benchmarks
expected_area <- c(288339954, 357780645, 439391462, 423934564, 682952609, 166702166)
expected_cov  <- c(0.970, 0.997, 0.996, 0.993, 0.990, 0.970)
geo_summary <- focus %>%
  left_join(st_drop_geometry(cpa_sf) %>% select(cpa, area_sqft), by = "cpa") %>%
  left_join(tract_xwalk %>% group_by(cpa) %>%
              summarise(tracts = n(), covered = sum(int_area),
                        tract_land = sum(tract_area)), by = "cpa") %>%
  mutate(coverage = covered / area_sqft, outside_share = 1 - covered / tract_land)
for (i in seq_along(focus_cpas)) {
  qa_add(1, paste0("CPA area, sq ft, ", focus_cpas[i]), fmt(expected_area[i]),
         fmt(geo_summary$area_sqft[i]), abs(geo_summary$area_sqft[i] - expected_area[i]) <= 1)
  qa_add(1, paste0("CPA land covered by its tracts, ", focus_cpas[i]), pct(expected_cov[i]),
         pct(geo_summary$coverage[i]), abs(round(geo_summary$coverage[i], 3) - expected_cov[i]) < 0.0015)
}

# ---- Parcel tagging (only when stage 2 runs) ---------------------------------
# County parcels from LACounty_Parcels.shp (EPSG:2229). Each polygon is assigned
# to the CPA and tract containing its interior point (st_point_on_surface).
# parcel_geo holds every City parcel's attributes; geometry is kept for the six
# CPAs only (parcel_geo_six).
if (run2) {
  if (!params$refresh && file.exists(f_geo_cache)) {
    geo <- readRDS(f_geo_cache)
  } else {
    if (!file.exists(params$path_parcel_shp))   # unzip into a gitignored folder
      unzip(params$path_parcel_zip, exdir = dirname(dirname(params$path_parcel_shp)))
    layer <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(params$path_parcel_shp))
    pg <- st_read(params$path_parcel_shp, quiet = TRUE,
                  query = sprintf('SELECT AIN, Shape_Area FROM "%s"', layer),
                  wkt_filter = st_as_text(st_as_sfc(st_bbox(cpa_sf)))) %>% to_ft()
    ok <- st_is_valid(pg)
    bad <- which(is.na(ok) | !ok)
    if (length(bad)) st_geometry(pg)[bad] <- st_geometry(st_make_valid(pg[bad, ]))
    pts <- st_point_on_surface(st_geometry(pg))
    first_hit <- function(idx) vapply(idx, function(i) if (length(i)) i[1] else NA_integer_, 1L)
    cpa_hits <- st_intersects(pts, cpa_sf)
    pg$cpa  <- cpa_sf$cpa[first_hit(cpa_hits)]
    pg$ct20 <- tracts_sf$CT20[first_hit(st_intersects(pts, tracts_sf))]
    xy <- st_coordinates(pts)
    pg$pt_x <- xy[, 1]; pg$pt_y <- xy[, 2]
    n_multi_cpa <- sum(lengths(cpa_hits) > 1)
    pg <- pg[!is.na(pg$cpa), ]                       # City parcels only
    pg$lot_sqft <- as.numeric(st_area(pg))
    pg$AIN <- str_trim(pg$AIN)
    geo <- list(parcel_geo     = st_drop_geometry(pg),
                parcel_geo_six = pg[pg$cpa %in% focus_cpas, c("AIN", "cpa", "ct20")],
                n_invalid_fixed = length(bad), n_multi_cpa = n_multi_cpa)
    saveRDS(geo, f_geo_cache)
    rm(pg, pts, xy); invisible(gc())
  }
  parcel_geo <- geo$parcel_geo
  # A parcel whose interior point falls just outside the tract layer (a coastline
  # mismatch between the two files) takes the nearest tract within 50 ft, the
  # same tolerance as the coordinate join; it is listed in the QA log.
  no_tract <- which(is.na(parcel_geo$ct20))
  snapped <- character(0)
  if (length(no_tract)) {
    np <- st_as_sf(parcel_geo[no_tract, c("AIN", "pt_x", "pt_y")], coords = c("pt_x", "pt_y"), crs = crs_ft)
    nf <- st_nearest_feature(np, tracts_sf)
    dd <- as.numeric(st_distance(np, tracts_sf[nf, ], by_element = TRUE))
    ok <- dd <= 50
    parcel_geo$ct20[no_tract[ok]] <- tracts_sf$CT20[nf[ok]]
    snapped <- sprintf("%s (%s, %.1f ft to tract %s)", parcel_geo$AIN[no_tract[ok]],
                       parcel_geo$cpa[no_tract[ok]], dd[ok], tracts_sf$CT20[nf[ok]])
  }
  parcel_geo <- parcel_geo %>% mutate(tract_cpa = tract_xwalk$cpa[match(ct20, tract_xwalk$CT20)])
  parcel_geo_six <- geo$parcel_geo_six
  qa_add(1, "Parcel interior points falling in two CPAs", "0", geo$n_multi_cpa,
         geo$n_multi_cpa == 0, stop_if_fail = TRUE)
  qa_add(1, "Parcels whose interior point lies just outside the tract layer, given the nearest tract within 50 ft",
         "listed", if (length(snapped)) paste(snapped, collapse = "; ") else "none", TRUE)
  qa_add(1, "City parcels with a CPA but no tract", "0", sum(is.na(parcel_geo$ct20)),
         !any(is.na(parcel_geo$ct20)), stop_if_fail = TRUE)
  qa_add(1, "Invalid parcel polygons repaired with st_make_valid()", "recorded",
         geo$n_invalid_fixed, TRUE)
}
```

ACS data follow the tract lists. ACS reports whole tracts, so a CPA's demographic totals describe its tracts, not its exact boundary.

## Parcels and land use definitions

Parcel shapes come from the County parcel file (exported August 2, 2025) and attributes from the 2026 Assessor roll, joined on AIN. One polygon is one parcel. A parcel belongs to the CPA and tract that contain its interior point. Lot size is the polygon's area in square feet.

**Land use class** comes from the roll's `Property Use Type`:

- **Single-family**: `Property Use Type` is SFR. A house stays single-family when the Assessor records an ADU on the lot.
- **Multi-family, 2–4 units**: R-I with a use code beginning 02, 03 or 04.
- **Multi-family, 5+ units**: R-I with a use code beginning 05, plus R-I parcels coded as manufactured homes or parks.
- **Other**: condominiums (CND), commercial or industrial (C/I), vacant (VAC), other (OTH), and parcels with no roll record.

State ADU law treats a structure with two or more attached units as multi-family, so a duplex is multi-family here.

**Hillside-fire flag.** The City's ADU ordinance bars an ADU on any lot that lies in both a Very High Fire Hazard Severity Zone and a Hillside Area unless the ADU meets one of two exceptions ([LAMC 12.22 A.33(c)(4)](https://cityclerk.lacity.org/onlinedocs/2016/16-1468_ord_draft_12-05-2019.pdf), Ordinance No. 186,481, adopted December 11, 2019 and effective December 19, 2019). The first exempts lots in the Northeast Los Angeles and Silver Lake - Echo Park - Elysian Valley CPAs outright (12.22 A.33(c)(4)(i)). The second allows the ADU anywhere else if it has an automatic fire sprinkler system, one off-street parking space, and frontage on a street improved with at least 20 feet of unobstructed roadway along the whole lot frontage (12.22 A.33(c)(4)(ii)).

<div style="margin-left: 2em;">

**Definition subject to change.** The City is rewriting this rule and does not enforce it as written. Since December 30, 2024, City Planning has not applied it to ADUs that state law requires cities to approve ([ZA Memo 143](https://planning.lacity.gov/odocument/184600d8-71d7-4d74-baf1-1f9cd2603320/ZA_Memo_No_143.pdf)), and HCD found the rule inconsistent with state ADU law ([November 19, 2024](https://www.hcd.ca.gov/sites/default/files/docs/policy-and-research/ordinance-review-letters/los-angeles-adu-findings-111924.pdf)). For ADUs approved under the City's own ordinance, the same memo identifies the sprinkler, parking and street-improvement conditions as conflicting with state law. A [draft ordinance dated September 3, 2026](https://planning.lacity.gov/odocument/8b7f0e87-9dff-431c-ba5b-fe85bce00fd6/ADU_Ordinance.pdf) keeps the restriction and the two-CPA exemption for ADUs approved under the City's ordinance; it has not been adopted. The Council's [September 2024 direction](https://cityclerk.lacity.org/onlinedocs/2016/16-1468-S2_CAF_9-11-24.pdf) to repeal the exemption is not reflected in that draft. How this report should treat these lots is one of the decisions to be made in setting the eligibility tiers.

**Implementation.** This report applies the ordinance as adopted in 2019. `hillside_fire` is TRUE when the parcel's interior point lies in both the fire hazard layer and the hillside layer and the CPA is not exempt. The sprinkler, parking and street-width conditions cannot be tested with these files, so a flagged lot is not necessarily barred and tier B is an upper bound on what the restriction removes.

</div>

```{r stage2-parcels}
# =============================================================================
# STAGE 2. PARCELS AND LAND USE
# Joins the 2026 roll to parcel_geo on AIN, computes lot area, attaches the land
# use class and the hillside-fire flag. Keeps every City parcel's class for the
# citywide ranking, and geometry for the six CPAs only.
# Stops the knit if: a property has no CPA, or classes do not sum to the total.
# =============================================================================
if (run2) {
  # ---- Roll: every column as character, BOM handled by
  # readr; drop the trailing rows that hold only an OBJECTID (empty AIN).
  roll_raw <- read_csv(params$path_roll,
                       col_select = c("AIN", "City Tax Rate Area", "Property Use Type",
                                      "Property Use Code", "Number of Units"),
                       col_types = cols(.default = col_character()),
                       progress = FALSE, name_repair = "minimal")
  n_roll_rows <- nrow(roll_raw)
  roll <- roll_raw %>%
    mutate(AIN = str_trim(AIN)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(AIN), AIN != "") %>%
    transmute(AIN, city_tra = str_trim(`City Tax Rate Area`),
              use_type = str_trim(`Property Use Type`),
              use_code = str_trim(`Property Use Code`),
              n_units  = as_num(`Number of Units`))
  rm(roll_raw)
  n_roll_dup <- sum(duplicated(roll$AIN))
  roll <- distinct(roll, AIN, .keep_all = TRUE)

  # Citywide use types on the roll's City parcels (City Tax Rate Area = LOS ANGELES)
  roll_city_types <- roll %>% filter(city_tra == "LOS ANGELES") %>% count(use_type)

  # ---- Hillside and fire layers, transformed from Web Mercator to EPSG:2229 ----
  hill_u <- st_read(params$path_hillside, quiet = TRUE) %>% st_make_valid() %>%
    st_transform(crs_ft) %>% st_union()
  fire_u <- st_read(params$path_fire, quiet = TRUE) %>% st_make_valid() %>%
    st_transform(crs_ft) %>% st_union()

  pts_all <- st_as_sf(parcel_geo[, c("pt_x", "pt_y")], coords = c("pt_x", "pt_y"), crs = crs_ft)
  parcel_class <- parcel_geo %>%
    left_join(roll, by = "AIN") %>%
    mutate(
      # lot area rounded to 0.01 sq ft so a lot of exactly 4,500 sq ft is not
      # pushed under the floor by floating-point noise
      lot_sqft = round(lot_sqft, 2),
      in_roll = !is.na(use_type),
      code2   = str_sub(use_code, 1, 2),
      land_use = case_when(
        !in_roll                                          ~ "Other",
        use_type == "SFR"                                 ~ "Single-family",
        use_type == "R-I" & code2 %in% c("02", "03", "04") ~ "Multi-family, 2-4 units",
        use_type == "R-I" & code2 %in% c("05", "07", "09") ~ "Multi-family, 5+ units",  # 07, 09: manufactured homes and parks
        TRUE                                              ~ "Other"),
      in_hill = lengths(st_intersects(pts_all, hill_u)) > 0,
      in_fire = lengths(st_intersects(pts_all, fire_u)) > 0,
      hillside_fire = in_hill & in_fire & !(cpa %in% fire_exempt_cpas),
      adu_code6 = use_type %in% "SFR" & str_sub(use_code, 4, 4) %in% "6")
  rm(pts_all); invisible(gc())

  # R-I parcels whose code fits neither multi-family rule (should be none)
  ri_unclassed <- parcel_class %>% filter(use_type %in% "R-I", land_use == "Other")

  # ---- Six-CPA property layer with geometry (prop_sf) --------------------------
  prop_sf <- parcel_geo_six %>%
    select(AIN, geometry) %>%
    left_join(parcel_class %>% filter(cpa %in% focus_cpas), by = "AIN")
  prop_six_simpl <- prop_sf %>% st_simplify(preserveTopology = TRUE, dTolerance = 1)

  saveRDS(parcel_class, f_parcels, compress = "xz")
  saveRDS(list(prop_sf = prop_six_simpl, roll_city_types = roll_city_types,
               n_roll_rows = n_roll_rows, n_roll_dup = n_roll_dup,
               ri_unclassed = nrow(ri_unclassed),
               n_city_parcels = nrow(parcel_geo)), f_prop_six, compress = "xz")
} else {
  parcel_class <- readRDS(f_parcels)
}
stage2 <- readRDS(f_prop_six)
if (!exists("prop_sf")) prop_sf <- stage2$prop_sf

# ---- Stage 2 checks ----------------------------------------------------------
qa_add(2, "Six-CPA parcels without a CPA", "0", sum(is.na(prop_sf$cpa)),
       !any(is.na(prop_sf$cpa)), stop_if_fail = TRUE)
lu_levels <- c("Single-family", "Multi-family, 2-4 units", "Multi-family, 5+ units", "Other")
qa_add(2, "Land use classes sum to total parcels", fmt(nrow(parcel_class)),
       fmt(sum(parcel_class$land_use %in% lu_levels)),
       sum(parcel_class$land_use %in% lu_levels) == nrow(parcel_class), stop_if_fail = TRUE)
qa_add(2, "R-I parcels outside both multi-family rules", "0", stage2$ri_unclassed,
       stage2$ri_unclassed == 0)
n_mh_six <- sum(prop_sf$use_type %in% "R-I" & prop_sf$code2 %in% c("07", "09"))
qa_add(2, "R-I parcels in the six CPAs coded as manufactured homes or parks (07, 09), counted as 5+ units",
       "15", n_mh_six, n_mh_six == 15)
qa_add(2, "Duplicate AINs in the 2026 roll", "0", stage2$n_roll_dup, stage2$n_roll_dup == 0)
qa_add(2, "Six-CPA parcels", "200,524", fmt(nrow(prop_sf)), nrow(prop_sf) == 200524)
n_no_roll <- sum(!prop_sf$in_roll)
qa_add(2, "Six-CPA parcels with no 2026 roll record (to Other, listed here)", "213",
       fmt(n_no_roll), n_no_roll == 213)
max_area_gap <- max(abs(prop_sf$lot_sqft - prop_sf$Shape_Area), na.rm = TRUE)
qa_add(2, "Lot area vs Shape_Area, largest gap in six CPAs (sq ft)", "< 400",
       fmt(max_area_gap, 1), max_area_gap < 400)

expected_types <- c(SFR = 471066, CND = 128620, `R-I` = 112573, `C/I` = 50406, VAC = 30697, OTH = 12539)
for (ty in names(expected_types)) {
  got <- stage2$roll_city_types$n[stage2$roll_city_types$use_type == ty]
  qa_add(2, paste0("City parcels on the roll typed ", ty), fmt(expected_types[[ty]]),
         fmt(sum(got)), sum(got) == expected_types[[ty]])
}
```

In Northeast Los Angeles, `r fmt(nela_both$parcels)` parcels lie in both the fire hazard and hillside layers, `r fmt(nela_both$elig)` of them eligible lots in tier A. The exemption keeps all of them in tier B; if the repeal the Council directed were adopted, those lots would face the same sprinkler, parking and street-width conditions as flagged lots elsewhere.

"Eligible" is an internal definition used in this report. The ordinance sets no minimum lot size, so the 4,500 sq ft floor, applied to single-family and multi-family lots alike, is a buildability screen: it marks lots with enough available buildable space to physically fit an ADU.

## ADU identification

ADU permits come from the Los Angeles Department of Building and Safety (LADBS), which publishes every building permit it issues on the City's open data portal. The City keeps that record in two datasets, one for permits issued from 2010 through 2019 and one for permits issued from 2020 to the present, so the two are merged into one file here. Together they run from January 2010 through `r fmt_date(asof_early)`. This report counts ADUs permitted from January 1, 2017, the date California's statewide ADU reforms (SB 1069 and AB 2299) took effect, through `r fmt_date(asof_early)`.

LADBS tags each permit with the number of ADUs and junior ADUs (JADUs) it adds or removes, in the `ADU_CHANGED` and `JUNIOR_ADU` fields. A permit is ADU-related when the two tags together are not zero (step 1). Given that a small group of ADU developments were permitted before the City's ADU tags were in consistent use, or were never tagged, we also add ADUs and JADUs based on permit descriptions (step 1b): original building permits from 2017 on whose use type is ADU or JADU and whose work description describes new construction, a conversion or an addition.

One ADU job often produces several permit records: the original building permit, plus supplemental permits filed later to revise or correct it (a change in plans or contractor, for example). LADBS numbers each supplement off its original permit, so the original and its supplements are grouped into one **permit chain**, and each chain is counted as one **project** (step 2). Without this step an ADU would be counted once for every permit filed for it. A few jobs were entered under two chains, and those are merged (step 2b). Each project then gets exactly one outcome, tested in this order: not active (dropped), completed, stalled, in progress.

- **Completed**: a `COFO_DATE` on any permit in the chain, or a status of CofO Issued, CofO Corrected, CofO Superseded, Permit Finaled or CofC Issued on any permit in the chain. This follows the state's Housing Element Annual Progress Report, which counts a unit as completed on a certificate of occupancy or other evidence of readiness for occupancy ([HCD, Annual Progress Report instructions](https://www.hcd.ca.gov/sites/default/files/docs/planning-and-community/housing-element-annual-progress-report-instructions.pdf); Government Code section 65400).
- **Stalled**: not completed, and the latest `STATUS_DATE` in the chain is on or before `r fmt_date(asof_early %m-% years(3))`, three years before the latest status date in the data. `STATUS_DATE` moves only when the status changes, so a stalled project has had no change in permit status for three years or more; inspections do not move it.
- **In progress**: not completed, with a status change within the last three years (after `r fmt_date(asof_early %m-% years(3))`).
- **Not active**: the original permit is Permit Expired, Permit Closed, Refund in Progress or Intent to Revoke, and no permit in the chain shows completion.

```{r stage3-adu}
  "Canoga Park-West Hills-Winnetka-Woodland Hill, Canoga Park-West Hills-Winnetka-Woodland Hills" = "Canoga Park - Winnetka - Woodland Hills - West Hills",
  "Canoga Park - West Hills - Winnetka - Woodland Hills" = "Canoga Park - Winnetka - Woodland Hills - West Hills",
  "Sherman Oaks - Studio City - Toluca Lake"       = "Sherman Oaks - Studio City - Toluca Lake - Cahuenga Pass",
  "Sherman Oaks-Studio City-Toluca Lake-Cahuenga"  = "Sherman Oaks - Studio City - Toluca Lake - Cahuenga Pass",
  "Sherman Oaks-Studio City-Toluca Lake-Cahuenga Pass" = "Sherman Oaks - Studio City - Toluca Lake - Cahuenga Pass",
  "Sherman Oaks-Studio City-Toluca Lake-Cahuenga, Sherman Oaks-Studio City-Toluca Lake-Cahuenga Pass" = "Sherman Oaks - Studio City - Toluca Lake - Cahuenga Pass",
  "Sunland-E LaTuna Cyn-Lakevw Ter-Shadow Hls-Tu"  = "Sunland - Tujunga - Lake View Terrace - Shadow Hills - East La Tuna Canyon",
  "Sunland-E LaTuna Cyn-Lakevw Ter-Shadow Hls-Tujunga" = "Sunland - Tujunga - Lake View Terrace - Shadow Hills - East La Tuna Canyon",
  "Sunland-E LaTuna Cyn-Lakevw Ter-Shadow Hls-Tu, Sunland-E LaTuna Cyn-Lakevw Ter-Shadow Hls-Tujunga" = "Sunland - Tujunga - Lake View Terrace - Shadow Hills - East La Tuna Canyon",
  "North Hollywood"     = "North Hollywood - Valley Village",
  "Central City"        = "Downtown",
  "Central City North"  = "Downtown")

if (run3) {
  keep_cols <- c("PERMIT_NBR", "PIN_NBR", "APN", "CPA", "PERMIT_TYPE", "PERMIT_SUB_TYPE", "USE_DESC",
                 "SUBMITTED_DATE", "ISSUE_DATE", "COFO_DATE", "ADU_CHANGED", "JUNIOR_ADU",
                 "STATUS_DESC", "STATUS_DATE", "WORK_DESC", "LAT", "LON")
  read_permits <- function(p) read_csv(p, col_select = all_of(keep_cols),
                                       col_types = cols(.default = col_character()), progress = FALSE)
  raw <- bind_rows(read_permits(params$path_permits_2010s), read_permits(params$path_permits_2020s)) %>%
    mutate(units_row = coalesce(as_num(ADU_CHANGED), 0) + coalesce(as_num(JUNIOR_ADU), 0),
           issue_dt  = mdy_(ISSUE_DATE), cofo_dt = mdy_(COFO_DATE),
           status_dt = mdy_(STATUS_DATE), submit_dt = mdy_(SUBMITTED_DATE),
           is_suppl  = as.integer(str_sub(PERMIT_NBR, 7, 11)) %% 10000 != 0,
           root      = parse_root(PERMIT_NBR))
  data_asof    <- max(raw$status_dt, na.rm = TRUE)
  stall_cutoff <- data_asof %m-% years(3)
  log_tbl <- tibble(step = "0", rule = "Merge the two datasets of all permits",
                    unit = "permit rows", remaining = nrow(raw))

  # Step 1: ADU permit rows (blanks as 0; negatives stay so corrections net out)
  adu_roots <- unique(raw$root[raw$units_row != 0])
  log_tbl <- add_row(log_tbl, step = "1", rule = "ADU_CHANGED + JUNIOR_ADU not equal to 0",
                     unit = "permit rows", remaining = sum(raw$units_row != 0))

  # Step 1b: permits the flag misses
  sec_pool <- raw %>%
    filter(!root %in% adu_roots, !is_suppl,
           USE_DESC %in% c("Accessory Dwelling Unit", "Junior Accessory Dwelling Unit"),
           str_starts(coalesce(PERMIT_TYPE, ""), "Bldg"), PERMIT_TYPE != "Bldg-Demolition",
           !is.na(issue_dt), issue_dt >= as.Date("2017-01-01"),
           str_detect(toupper(coalesce(WORK_DESC, "")), "NEW|CONVER|CONSTRUCT|BUILD|ADDITION|CREATE|CHANGE OF USE"))
  sec_roots <- setdiff(unique(sec_pool$root), adu_roots)
  all_roots <- union(adu_roots, sec_roots)
  log_tbl <- add_row(log_tbl, step = "1b", unit = "projects (permit chains)",
                     rule = sprintf("Add %s chains the flag misses: original 2017+ Bldg permits with an ADU or JADU use type and construction wording, no flag in the chain (one unit each)", fmt(length(sec_roots))),
                     remaining = length(all_roots))

  # Statuses seen on ADU-related rows issued since 2017
  status_rows <- raw %>%
    filter(!is.na(issue_dt), issue_dt >= as.Date("2017-01-01"),
           units_row != 0 | USE_DESC %in% c("Accessory Dwelling Unit", "Junior Accessory Dwelling Unit")) %>%
    count(STATUS_DESC, name = "rows", sort = TRUE)

  # Step 2: collapse supplements into projects
  chain <- raw %>% filter(root %in% all_roots) %>% arrange(root, issue_dt, PERMIT_NBR)
  first_flag <- chain %>%
    group_by(root) %>%
    mutate(has_flag = any(units_row != 0)) %>%
    filter(if (first(has_flag)) units_row != 0 else TRUE) %>%
    slice(1) %>% ungroup() %>%
    transmute(root, ff_permit = PERMIT_NBR, ff_issue_dt = issue_dt, pin = PIN_NBR, apn = APN,
              cpa_raw = CPA, lat = as_num(LAT), lon = as_num(LON), sub_type = PERMIT_SUB_TYPE,
              work_desc = WORK_DESC)
  min_or_na <- function(x) if (all(is.na(x))) as.Date(NA) else min(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_or_na <- function(x) if (all(is.na(x))) as.Date(NA) else max(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  agg <- chain %>%
    group_by(root) %>%
    summarise(
      units_raw_sum = sum(units_row),
      units = max(c(units_row[units_row > 0], 0)) + sum(units_row[units_row < 0]),
      status_orig = { o <- STATUS_DESC[!is_suppl]; if (length(o)) o[1] else STATUS_DESC[1] },
      any_cofo = any(!is.na(cofo_dt)),
      completed = any(!is.na(cofo_dt)) | any(STATUS_DESC %in% completed_statuses),
      last_activity = max_or_na(status_dt),
      submitted = { s <- min_or_na(submit_dt); if (is.na(s)) min_or_na(issue_dt) else s },
      submitted_from_issue = all(is.na(submit_dt)),
      cofo_min    = min_or_na(cofo_dt),
      cofostat_min = min_or_na(status_dt[STATUS_DESC %in% cofo_statuses]),
      fin_min     = min_or_na(status_dt[STATUS_DESC %in% c("Permit Finaled", "CofC Issued")]),
      has_cofostat = any(STATUS_DESC %in% cofo_statuses),
      has_fin     = any(STATUS_DESC %in% c("Permit Finaled", "CofC Issued")),
      .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(chain_basis = case_when(!completed ~ NA_character_, !is.na(cofo_min) ~ "CofO date",
                                   has_cofostat ~ "CofO status, no date", has_fin ~ "Finaled or CofC",
                                   TRUE ~ "Completed, no date"))
  projects <- first_flag %>% inner_join(agg, by = "root") %>%
    mutate(source_rule = if_else(root %in% sec_roots, "use-type/description", "inventory flag"),
           units = if_else(source_rule == "use-type/description" & units <= 0, 1, units))
  log_tbl <- add_row(log_tbl, step = "2", unit = "projects",
                     rule = "Collapse supplements into projects (middle group floored to 10,000); units = largest positive row + negative rows",
                     remaining = nrow(projects))

  # Step 2b: merge duplicate chains (same first and last permit-number groups and PIN)
  projects <- projects %>%
    mutate(gkey = if_else(is.na(pin), paste0("solo|", root),
                          paste(str_sub(root, 1, 5), str_sub(root, 13, 17), pin, sep = "|"))) %>%
    group_by(gkey) %>%
    arrange(desc(units), ff_issue_dt, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    summarise(across(c(root, ff_permit, pin, apn, cpa_raw, lat, lon, sub_type, work_desc,
                       status_orig, source_rule, chain_basis), first),
              units = max(units), units_raw_sum = sum(units_raw_sum),
              ff_issue_dt = min(ff_issue_dt, na.rm = TRUE),
              any_cofo = any(any_cofo), completed = any(completed),
              last_activity = max_or_na(last_activity),
              submitted = min_or_na(submitted),
              submitted_from_issue = all(submitted_from_issue),
              cofo_min = min_or_na(cofo_min), cofostat_min = min_or_na(cofostat_min),
              fin_min = min_or_na(fin_min), has_cofostat = any(has_cofostat), has_fin = any(has_fin),
              n_chains = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    select(-gkey) %>%
    # Completion date, in priority order over the whole project:
    # earliest COFO_DATE; else the STATUS_DATE of the CofO-status permit; else
    # the STATUS_DATE of the Permit Finaled or CofC Issued permit.
    mutate(completion_basis = case_when(!completed ~ NA_character_,
                                        !is.na(cofo_min) ~ "CofO date",
                                        has_cofostat ~ "CofO status, no date",
                                        has_fin ~ "Finaled or CofC",
                                        TRUE ~ "Completed, no date"),
           completion_dt = case_when(completion_basis == "CofO date" ~ cofo_min,
                                     completion_basis == "CofO status, no date" ~ cofostat_min,
                                     completion_basis == "Finaled or CofC" ~ fin_min,
                                     TRUE ~ as.Date(NA)))
  log_tbl <- add_row(log_tbl, step = "2b", unit = "projects",
                     rule = "Merge duplicate chains: same first and last permit-number groups and same PIN_NBR",
                     remaining = nrow(projects))

  # Step 3: four typo projects set to 1 unit
  projects <- projects %>% mutate(units = if_else(root %in% typo_roots & units > 1, 1, units))
  log_tbl <- add_row(log_tbl, step = "3", unit = "projects", remaining = nrow(projects),
                     rule = "Set four typo projects (square footage typed as units) to 1 unit")

  # Step 4: drop projects that net to 0 or fewer units
  projects <- filter(projects, units > 0)
  log_tbl <- add_row(log_tbl, step = "4", unit = "projects", remaining = nrow(projects),
                     rule = "Drop projects that net to 0 or fewer units (demolitions, removals, reversed scopes)")

  # Step 5: drop projects that are not active
  projects <- filter(projects, !(status_orig %in% invalid_statuses & !completed))
  log_tbl <- add_row(log_tbl, step = "5", unit = "projects", remaining = nrow(projects),
                     rule = "Drop not active: original permit Expired, Closed, Refund in Progress or Intent to Revoke, with no completion evidence in the chain")

  # Step 6: normalize permit CPA spellings (citywide log only)
  projects <- projects %>%
    mutate(cpa_text = if_else(is.na(cpa_raw), "Unknown", recode(cpa_raw, !!!cpa_spelling)))
  log_tbl <- add_row(log_tbl, step = "6", unit = "projects", remaining = nrow(projects),
                     rule = sprintf("Normalize permit CPA spellings (%s projects respelled); used for the citywide log only",
                                    fmt(sum(projects$cpa_text != coalesce(projects$cpa_raw, "Unknown")))))

  # Step 7: one status per project, with the <= cutoff
  projects <- projects %>%
    mutate(status = case_when(
      completed ~ "Completed",
      !is.na(last_activity) & last_activity <= stall_cutoff ~ "Stalled",
      TRUE ~ "In progress"),
      status = factor(status, levels = names(pal_status)))
  log_tbl <- add_row(log_tbl, step = "7", unit = "projects", remaining = nrow(projects),
                     rule = sprintf("Assign one status: completed, stalled (last status change on or before %s), or in progress",
                                    format(stall_cutoff, "%B %d, %Y")))

  # Step 8: keep projects whose first ADU-flagged permit was issued in the window
  projects <- projects %>%
    filter(!is.na(ff_issue_dt), ff_issue_dt >= as.Date("2017-01-01"), ff_issue_dt <= data_asof) %>%
    mutate(issue_year = year(ff_issue_dt))
  log_tbl <- add_row(log_tbl, step = "8", unit = "projects", remaining = nrow(projects),
                     rule = sprintf("Keep projects whose first ADU-flagged permit was issued January 1, 2017 to %s",
                                    format(data_asof, "%B %d, %Y")))
  log_tbl <- log_tbl %>% mutate(dropped = lag(remaining) - remaining,
                                dropped = if_else(step %in% c("0", "1", "1b", "2"), NA_real_, dropped))

  saveRDS(list(projects = projects, log_tbl = log_tbl, status_rows = status_rows,
               data_asof = data_asof, stall_cutoff = stall_cutoff,
               n_sec_final = sum(projects$source_rule == "use-type/description")), f_projects)
  rm(raw, chain, agg, first_flag, sec_pool); invisible(gc())
}
s3 <- readRDS(f_projects)
projects <- s3$projects; log_tbl <- s3$log_tbl %>% mutate(rule = if_else(step == "0", "Merge the two datasets of all permits", rule)); data_asof <- s3$data_asof; stall_cutoff <- s3$stall_cutoff
window_label <- paste0("January 1, 2017 to ", format(data_asof, "%B %e, %Y") %>% str_squish())

# ---- Stage 3 checks ----------------------------------------------------------
st_n <- table(projects$status)
qa_add(3, "Completed + in progress + stalled = total (projects)", fmt(nrow(projects)), fmt(sum(st_n)),
       sum(st_n) == nrow(projects), stop_if_fail = TRUE)
st_u <- tapply(projects$units, projects$status, sum)
qa_add(3, "Completed + in progress + stalled = total (units)", fmt(sum(projects$units)), fmt(sum(st_u)),
       isTRUE(all.equal(sum(st_u), sum(projects$units))), stop_if_fail = TRUE)
qa_add(3, "Projects without a last status date (cannot be classified)", "0",
       sum(is.na(projects$last_activity) & !projects$completed),
       sum(is.na(projects$last_activity) & !projects$completed) == 0)
unknown_status <- setdiff(s3$status_rows$STATUS_DESC, known_statuses)
qa_add(3, "Statuses on ADU rows outside the status table (treated as open)", "none",
       if (length(unknown_status)) paste(unknown_status, collapse = "; ") else "none", length(unknown_status) == 0)
qa_add(3, "data_asof = max(STATUS_DATE)", "2026-10-31", format(data_asof), data_asof == as.Date("2026-10-31"))
qa_add(3, "Dates in the definitions box match stage 3 (latest status date)", format(data_asof), format(asof_early),
       identical(as.Date(asof_early), as.Date(data_asof)), stop_if_fail = TRUE)
qa_add(0, "Permit extract download date read from the file name", "a date", format(extract_date), !is.na(extract_date), stop_if_fail = TRUE)
qa_add(3, "Stalled cutoff = data_asof minus 3 years", "2023-10-31", format(stall_cutoff),
       stall_cutoff == as.Date("2023-10-31"))
# Benchmarks from earlier computations
qa_add(3, "Earlier run: projects citywide", "51,467", fmt(nrow(projects)), nrow(projects) == 51467)
qa_add(3, "Earlier run: units citywide", "55,155", fmt(sum(projects$units)), sum(projects$units) == 55155)
# The status benchmark came from an earlier test computation. Compare
# with the earlier R output too: completed units should match it exactly, and
# the <= cutoff should move exactly the units whose last status change falls on
# the cutoff date from in progress to stalled.
old_out <- read_csv(params$path_old_projects, col_types = cols(.default = "c")) %>%
  mutate(units = as_num(units), status = case_when(outcome == "Completed" ~ "Completed",
                                                   str_starts(outcome, "Stalled") ~ "Stalled",
                                                   TRUE ~ "In progress"))
old_u <- tapply(old_out$units, old_out$status, sum)
at_cutoff <- sum(projects$units[!projects$completed & projects$last_activity %in% stall_cutoff])
consistent_old <- st_u[["Completed"]] == old_u[["Completed"]] &&
  st_u[["Stalled"]] == old_u[["Stalled"]] + at_cutoff &&
  st_u[["In progress"]] == old_u[["In progress"]] - at_cutoff
qa_add(3, "Earlier run: units completed / in progress / stalled", "39,575 / 11,812 / 3,768",
       paste(fmt(st_u[c("Completed", "In progress", "Stalled")]), collapse = " / "),
       all(st_u[c("Completed", "In progress", "Stalled")] == c(39575, 11812, 3768)),
       reason = if (consistent_old) sprintf(
         "The target came from an earlier test computation. Completed units equal the earlier R output exactly (%s); the <= cutoff moves the %d units whose last status change is exactly %s from in progress to stalled (earlier split %s / %s / %s).",
         fmt(old_u[["Completed"]]), at_cutoff, format(stall_cutoff), fmt(old_u[["Completed"]]),
         fmt(old_u[["In progress"]]), fmt(old_u[["Stalled"]])) else NA_character_)
qa_add(3, "Earlier run: step 1b projects in the final table", "918", fmt(s3$n_sec_final), s3$n_sec_final == 918)
qa_add(3, "Earlier run: ADU-related rows issued since 2017", "65,728",
       fmt(sum(s3$status_rows$rows)), sum(s3$status_rows$rows) == 65728)
n_cofostat <- sum(projects$completion_basis %in% "CofO status, no date")
n_fin <- sum(projects$completion_basis %in% "Finaled or CofC")
merged_diff <- sum(projects$n_chains > 1 & coalesce(projects$chain_basis, "-") != coalesce(projects$completion_basis, "-"))
qa_add(3, "Earlier run: completed projects dated by CofO status without a date / by Finaled or CofC",
       "610 / 1,357", paste(fmt(n_cofostat), fmt(n_fin), sep = " / "), n_cofostat == 610 & n_fin == 1357,
       reason = if (abs(n_cofostat - 610) + abs(n_fin - 1357) <= merged_diff) sprintf(
         "The target counted each project's own permit chain. Step 2b merges duplicate chains, and in %d merged projects the merged chain has a different completion basis (a CofO date on the other chain, or completion only on the other chain); the gap is within those.",
         merged_diff) else NA_character_)
qa_add(3, "Earlier run: projects dated by issue date because SUBMITTED_DATE is blank", "56",
```

## Joining ADUs to parcels, tracts and CPAs

Each project joins to a County parcel in three steps: the permit APN to the parcel AIN; then, if unmatched, the permit `PIN_NBR` to the City parcel file's PIN, whose BPP gives the APN; then, if still unmatched, the parcel containing the project's coordinates, or the nearest parcel within 50 ft. A project inherits its parcel's AIN (`prop_id`), CPA, tract, land use class, lot size and hillside-fire flag, so ADU counts and lot counts share one parcel ID. A project that no step places keeps its permit CPA text for CPA totals, with property type "unknown".

The Assessor's four-character property use code records ADUs on single-family parcels. In a code such as `01D6`, the characters read 0 = residential, 1 = single-family residence, D = detached and 6 = "ADU - Accessory Dwelling Unit (less than 1,200 sq ft, kitchen and bath)"; the [Assessor Portal](https://portal.assessor.lacounty.gov/) decodes each character on a parcel's detail page. Single-family parcels whose fourth use-code character is 6 but that hold no project are tagged **older or unpermitted ADUs** (`older_adu`). They get their own count and are never added to permitted ADU units.

```{r stage4-join}
# =============================================================================
# STAGE 4. ADU-TO-PARCEL JOIN (with the older or unpermitted ADU tag)
# Joins projects to properties, then assigns tract, CPA and property type from
# the property. Tags single-family parcels coded as having an ADU but holding no
# project as older_adu.
# Stops the knit if: the match rate falls below 99%.
# =============================================================================
if (run4) {
  pc <- parcel_class %>% filter(!is.na(AIN), AIN != "") %>% distinct(AIN, .keep_all = TRUE)
  p <- projects %>%
    mutate(apn10 = str_trim(apn), pin_n = str_squish(pin), prop_id = NA_character_, join_step = NA_character_)

  # Step 1: permit APN = parcel AIN
  i1 <- which(p$apn10 %in% pc$AIN)
  p$prop_id[i1] <- p$apn10[i1]; p$join_step[i1] <- "1. APN"

  # Step 2: PIN_NBR (internal spaces collapsed) -> City parcel PIN -> BPP -> AIN
  cp_layer <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(params$path_city_parcels))
  city_pin <- st_read(params$path_city_parcels, quiet = TRUE,
                      query = sprintf('SELECT PIN, BPP FROM "%s"', cp_layer)) %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    transmute(pin_n = str_squish(PIN), bpp = str_trim(BPP)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(pin_n), pin_n != "", str_detect(coalesce(bpp, ""), "^[0-9]{10}$")) %>%  # skip masked BPPs
    distinct(pin_n, .keep_all = TRUE)
  i2 <- which(is.na(p$prop_id) & !is.na(p$pin_n))
  bpp2 <- city_pin$bpp[match(p$pin_n[i2], city_pin$pin_n)]
  ok2 <- !is.na(bpp2) & bpp2 %in% pc$AIN
  n_pin_bpp_outside <- sum(!is.na(bpp2) & !(bpp2 %in% pc$AIN))   # BPP is not a City parcel AIN
  p$prop_id[i2[ok2]] <- bpp2[ok2]; p$join_step[i2[ok2]] <- "2. City PIN"
  n_city_pins <- nrow(city_pin); rm(city_pin)

  # Step 3: coordinates -> containing parcel, else nearest parcel within 50 ft
  if (!file.exists(params$path_parcel_shp))
    unzip(params$path_parcel_zip, exdir = dirname(dirname(params$path_parcel_shp)))
  layer <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(params$path_parcel_shp))
  read_ains <- function(ains) {   # County polygons for a set of AINs
    if (!length(ains)) return(st_sf(AIN = character(0), geometry = st_sfc(crs = crs_ft)))
    st_read(params$path_parcel_shp, quiet = TRUE,
            query = sprintf('SELECT AIN FROM "%s" WHERE AIN IN (%s)', layer,
                            paste0("'", ains, "'", collapse = ","))) %>%
      to_ft() %>% mutate(AIN = str_trim(AIN))
  }
  i3 <- which(is.na(p$prop_id) & !is.na(p$lat) & !is.na(p$lon) & p$lat != 0 & p$lon != 0)
  n_coord_tried <- length(i3)
  if (length(i3)) {
    pts3 <- st_as_sf(p[i3, c("root", "lon", "lat")], coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = crs_web) %>%
      st_transform(crs_ft)
    near_wkt <- st_as_text(st_union(st_buffer(pts3, 60)))
    cand <- st_read(params$path_parcel_shp, quiet = TRUE,
                    query = sprintf('SELECT AIN FROM "%s"', layer), wkt_filter = near_wkt) %>%
      to_ft() %>% mutate(AIN = str_trim(AIN)) %>% filter(AIN %in% pc$AIN)
    okv <- st_is_valid(cand); if (any(!okv | is.na(okv))) cand <- st_make_valid(cand)
    hit <- st_intersects(pts3, cand)
    in_aid <- vapply(hit, function(h) if (length(h)) cand$AIN[h[1]] else NA_character_, "")
    miss <- which(is.na(in_aid))
    near_aid <- rep(NA_character_, length(in_aid))
    if (length(miss) && nrow(cand)) {
      nf <- st_nearest_feature(pts3[miss, ], cand)
      d  <- as.numeric(st_distance(pts3[miss, ], cand[nf, ], by_element = TRUE))
      near_aid[miss] <- ifelse(d <= 50, cand$AIN[nf], NA_character_)
    }
    p$prop_id[i3]   <- coalesce(in_aid, near_aid)
    p$join_step[i3] <- case_when(!is.na(in_aid) ~ "3. Coordinates, inside parcel",
                                 !is.na(near_aid) ~ "3. Coordinates, nearest within 50 ft",
                                 TRUE ~ NA_character_)
  }
  p$join_step[is.na(p$prop_id)] <- "4. Unmatched (permit CPA text)"

  # Inherit parcel attributes
  adu <- p %>%
    left_join(pc %>% select(prop_id = AIN, parcel_cpa = cpa, ct20, tract_cpa, land_use,
                            lot_sqft, hillside_fire, in_roll, use_type, pt_x, pt_y),
              by = "prop_id") %>%
    mutate(cpa = coalesce(parcel_cpa, cpa_text),
           property_type = case_when(
             !is.na(prop_id) & land_use == "Single-family" ~ "Single-family",
             !is.na(prop_id) & str_starts(land_use, "Multi-family") ~ "Multi-family",
             !is.na(prop_id) ~ "Other",
             sub_type %in% "Apartment" ~ "Multi-family",   # fallback
             TRUE ~ "Unknown"))

  # older_adu: SFR parcels coded 6 that the full join ties to no permitted project
  parcel_class <- parcel_class %>%
    mutate(older_adu = adu_code6 & !(AIN %in% adu$prop_id))
  older_counts <- parcel_class %>% filter(older_adu) %>% count(cpa, ct20, name = "older_adu")

  # ---- Diagnostics for the benchmarks ---------
  # (a) Permit APNs that are County AINs outside the City parcel table
  un_apn <- unique(p$apn10[!(p$apn10 %in% pc$AIN) & str_detect(coalesce(p$apn10, ""), "^[0-9]{10}$")])
  apn_outside_set <- read_ains(un_apn)$AIN
  n_apn_outside <- sum(p$apn10 %in% apn_outside_set)
  # (a2) PIN-step BPPs that are County AINs outside the City parcel table, for
  #      projects the target's PIN step would have seen
  county_bpp <- read_ains(unique(bpp2[!is.na(bpp2) & !(bpp2 %in% pc$AIN)]))$AIN
  n_pin_bpp_county_outside <- sum(!is.na(bpp2) & bpp2 %in% county_bpp & !(p$apn10[i2] %in% apn_outside_set))
  # (b) Tagged parcels that contain the point of a project already placed by
  #     APN or PIN (an earlier test removed these too)
  tag_cand <- parcel_class$AIN[parcel_class$older_adu]
  tag_poly <- read_ains(tag_cand)
  allpts <- adu %>% filter(!is.na(lat), !is.na(lon), lat != 0, lon != 0) %>%
    st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = crs_web) %>% st_transform(crs_ft)
  hit_tag <- unique(tag_poly$AIN[unlist(st_intersects(allpts, tag_poly))])
  hit_tag_cpa <- parcel_class %>% filter(AIN %in% hit_tag) %>% count(cpa)

  saveRDS(list(adu = adu, older_counts = older_counts,
               n_apn_outside = n_apn_outside, n_pin_bpp_outside = n_pin_bpp_outside,
               n_pin_bpp_county_outside = n_pin_bpp_county_outside,
               hit_tag = hit_tag, hit_tag_cpa = hit_tag_cpa,
               n_code6 = sum(parcel_class$adu_code6),
               n_code6_with_project = sum(parcel_class$adu_code6 & parcel_class$AIN %in% adu$prop_id),
               n_city_pins = n_city_pins, n_coord_tried = n_coord_tried), f_joined)
}
```

## ACS variables and margins of error

Community data come from the American Community Survey 2020–2024 5-year estimates for census tracts in Los Angeles County, joined to the crosswalk on GEOID (never on the tract name). Counts are summed across a CPA's tracts; rates and averages are recomputed from the summed counts, never averaged across tracts. Margins of error use the tidycensus helpers, which apply the Census Bureau's approximation formulas: `moe_sum()` for sums and differences, `moe_prop()` for shares whose numerator is part of the denominator, and `moe_ratio()` for the vacancy rates and averages. The Census Bureau warns these approximations weaken as more estimates are combined, so CPA margins of error are approximate. An estimate is flagged **low reliability** when its coefficient of variation, (MOE ÷ 1.645) ÷ estimate, exceeds 30%.

```{r stage5-acs}
# =============================================================================
# STAGE 5. ACS
# Pulls tract estimates and margins of error, keeps crosswalk tracts, aggregates
# to CPA. The key is read from .Renviron and never printed.
# Stops the knit if: a crosswalk tract is missing from the pull, or the five
# household counts disagree in any tract.
# =============================================================================

  rb_30 = c("B25070_007", "B25070_008", "B25070_009", "B25070_010"), rb_50 = "B25070_010",
  hu = "DP04_0001", occ = "DP04_0002", vac = "DP04_0003",
  ed_univ = "B15003_001", ed_ba = c("B15003_022", "B15003_023", "B15003_024", "B15003_025"),

  v_rent = "B25004_002", v_rented = "B25004_003", v_sale = "B25004_004", v_sold = "B25004_005",
  emp_occ = "DP03_0026", occ_wc = c("DP03_0028", "DP03_0029", "DP03_0030", "DP03_0031"),

  mutate(estimate = if_else(!is.na(estimate) & estimate <= -1e8, NA_real_, estimate),
         moe = case_when(moe == -555555555 ~ 0,            # controlled estimate: no sampling error
                         !is.na(moe) & moe < 0 ~ NA_real_,

# ---- Components and measures for any grouping (tract or CPA) -----------------
component_table <- function(d, group) {
  imap_dfr(comp, function(vars, nm) {
    d %>% filter(variable %in% vars) %>% group_by(group = .data[[group]]) %>%
      summarise(estimate = sum(estimate, na.rm = TRUE),
                moe = moe_sum(moe, estimate, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(comp = nm)
  })
}
rss <- function(...) sqrt(rowSums(cbind(...)^2))
build_measures <- function(ct) {
  w  <- ct %>% select(group, comp, estimate) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = comp, values_from = estimate)
  wm <- ct %>% select(group, comp, moe) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = comp, values_from = moe)
  E <- function(x) w[[x]]; M <- function(x) wm[[x]]
  rb_comp_e <- E("rb_all") - E("rb_nc"); rb_comp_m <- rss(M("rb_all"), M("rb_nc"))
  ov_den_e <- E("own_b25003") + E("v_sale") + E("v_sold"); ov_den_m <- rss(M("own_b25003"), M("v_sale"), M("v_sold"))
  rv_den_e <- E("rent_b25003") + E("v_rent") + E("v_rented"); rv_den_m <- rss(M("rent_b25003"), M("v_rent"), M("v_rented"))
  cnt <- function(lbl, e, m) tibble(group = w$group, measure = lbl, type = "count", estimate = e, moe = m)
  prp <- function(lbl, ne, nm, de, dm) tibble(group = w$group, measure = lbl, type = "rate",
                                               estimate = ne / de, moe = moe_prop(ne, de, nm, dm))
  rat <- function(lbl, ne, nm, de, dm, type = "average") tibble(group = w$group, measure = lbl, type = type,
                                                                 estimate = ne / de, moe = moe_ratio(ne, de, nm, dm))
  bind_rows(
    cnt("Total population", E("pop"), M("pop")),
    cnt("Total households", E("hh"), M("hh")),
    cnt("Owner households", E("own"), M("own")),
    cnt("Renter households", E("rent"), M("rent")),
    cnt("Owner households that moved in 2020 or later", E("own_moved20"), M("own_moved20")),
    cnt("Owner households that moved in 2023 or later", E("own_moved23"), M("own_moved23")),
    cnt("Households with poverty status", E("pov_univ"), M("pov_univ")),
    cnt("Households below poverty", E("pov_below"), M("pov_below")),
    cnt("Latino households", E("lat_hh"), M("lat_hh")),
    cnt("Latino owner households", E("lat_own"), M("lat_own")),
    cnt("Black households", E("blk_hh"), M("blk_hh")),
    cnt("Black owner households", E("blk_own"), M("blk_own")),
    cnt("Non-Hispanic white households", E("wht_hh"), M("wht_hh")),
    cnt("Non-Hispanic white owner households", E("wht_own"), M("wht_own")),
    cnt("Renter households with a computed rent burden", rb_comp_e, rb_comp_m),
    cnt("Rent-burdened households", E("rb_30"), M("rb_30")),
    cnt("Severely rent-burdened households", E("rb_50"), M("rb_50")),
    cnt("Total housing units", E("hu"), M("hu")),
    cnt("Occupied housing units", E("occ"), M("occ")),
    cnt("Vacant housing units", E("vac"), M("vac")),
    cnt("Adults 25 and over", E("ed_univ"), M("ed_univ")),
    cnt("Adults 25 and over with a bachelor's degree or higher", E("ed_ba"), M("ed_ba")),
    rat("Average household income", E("agg_inc"), M("agg_inc"), E("hh_b11001"), M("hh_b11001")),
    rat("Average gross rent", E("agg_rent"), M("agg_rent"), E("rent_cash"), M("rent_cash")),
    prp("Homeownership rate", E("own"), M("own"), E("hh"), M("hh")),
    prp("Latino homeownership rate", E("lat_own"), M("lat_own"), E("lat_hh"), M("lat_hh")),
    prp("Black homeownership rate", E("blk_own"), M("blk_own"), E("blk_hh"), M("blk_hh")),
    prp("Non-Hispanic white homeownership rate", E("wht_own"), M("wht_own"), E("wht_hh"), M("wht_hh")),
    prp("Latino share of owner households", E("lat_own"), M("lat_own"), E("own_b25003"), M("own_b25003")),
    prp("Black share of owner households", E("blk_own"), M("blk_own"), E("own_b25003"), M("own_b25003")),
    prp("Non-Hispanic white share of owner households", E("wht_own"), M("wht_own"), E("own_b25003"), M("own_b25003")),
    prp("Share of owners that moved in 2020 or later", E("own_moved20"), M("own_moved20"), E("own"), M("own")),
    prp("Share of owners that moved in 2023 or later", E("own_moved23"), M("own_moved23"), E("own"), M("own")),
    prp("Household poverty rate", E("pov_below"), M("pov_below"), E("pov_univ"), M("pov_univ")),
    prp("Rent-burden rate", E("rb_30"), M("rb_30"), rb_comp_e, rb_comp_m),
    prp("Severe rent-burden rate", E("rb_50"), M("rb_50"), rb_comp_e, rb_comp_m),
    prp("Homeowner vacancy rate", E("v_sale"), M("v_sale"), ov_den_e, ov_den_m),
    prp("Rental vacancy rate", E("v_rent"), M("v_rent"), rv_den_e, rv_den_m),
    prp("Share of adults 25+ with a bachelor's degree or higher", E("ed_ba"), M("ed_ba"), E("ed_univ"), M("ed_univ"))
  ) %>%
    mutate(cv = (moe / 1.645) / estimate,
           low_reliability = !is.na(cv) & is.finite(cv) & cv > 0.30)
}
acs_cpa <- component_table(acs_long, "cpa") %>% build_measures() %>% rename(cpa = group)
acs_tract_meas <- component_table(acs_long, "GEOID") %>% build_measures() %>% rename(GEOID = group)
```
