## Working-class tract definition

There is no single standard definition of a working-class neighborhood. Published work defines the working class by education, by occupation or by income, and a smaller set of studies applies those ideas to census tracts. In this analysis, we draw on the following sources.

- **Education.** The Center for American Progress defines the working class as people in the labor force without a four-year college degree ([Rowell 2017](https://www.americanprogressaction.org/article/everyone-know-americas-diverse-working-class/); [Center for American Progress, "Understanding the Working Class and the Challenges It Faces"](https://www.americanprogress.org/article/understanding-the-working-class-and-the-challenges-it-faces/)).
- **Occupation.** Pew Research Center's 2026 study of who sees themselves as working class counts as blue-collar those who do manual or physical labor in manufacturing, mining and construction; agriculture, forestry, fishing and hunting; retail and trade; hospitality and service; or transportation ([Pew Research Center 2026](https://www.pewresearch.org/politics/2026/08/31/who-sees-themselves-as-working-class/)).
- **Income.** Reardon and Bischoff sort neighborhoods by the ratio of tract median family income to the metro median, from poor (under 0.67) to affluent (1.50 and over), with "low-middle" at 0.80 to 1.00 ([Reardon and Bischoff 2011](https://s4.ad.brown.edu/Projects/Diversity/Data/Report/report111111.pdf)).
- **Census tracts classed directly.** Two published approaches label tracts by the work their residents do. The Public Health Disparities Geocoding Project measures the share of employed residents in working-class occupations, meaning non-supervisory jobs, and treats areas at 66% or more as working-class ([Krieger et al. 2002](https://content.sph.harvard.edu/wwwhsph/sites/2068/2016/10/02_aje_krieger_et_al_geocode_mortality_cancer.pdf)). Florida and Adler label a tract by the occupational class (creative, service or working) that holds a plurality of its residents ([Florida and Adler 2018](https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/abs/10.1080/07352166.2017.1360743)). Other studies derive a working-class or blue-collar neighborhood type from cluster analysis (Morenoff and Tienda 1997; Delmelle 2016), which gives no cut-off to reuse.

None of these is adopted as is. Each of the tract-level rules rests on occupation alone, and Florida and Adler separate service workers from the working class, while this project counts them in it. In this analysis, a tract must instead look working-class on all three dimensions at once, each measured with an ACS tract table: education as the Center for American Progress defines it, occupation following Pew's list, and income on the Reardon and Bischoff scale. One difference from Pew: the ACS sales-and-office group also covers office and administrative support, so test B is somewhat broader than Pew's list.

**Definition used in this analysis.** A tract is **working-class** when all three tests hold:

- **A. Education**: at least 50% of adults 25 and over have no bachelor's degree: 1 − (B15003_022 + _023 + _024 + _025) ÷ B15003_001.
- **B. Occupation**: at least 50% of employed civilians 16 and over work in service; sales and office; natural resources, construction and maintenance; or production, transportation and material moving occupations: (DP03_0028 + DP03_0029 + DP03_0030 + DP03_0031) ÷ DP03_0026.
- **C. Income**: tract median family income is below the Los Angeles–Long Beach–Anaheim metro median (B19113_001 tract ÷ metro, ratio under 1.00, "low-middle" or lower on the Reardon and Bischoff scale).

A tract with under 100 residents or no published median family income gets no class.

**Borderline tracts.** ACS figures are estimates from a sample of households, so every share comes with a margin of error: the range the true value is likely to fall in (the Census Bureau publishes it at 90% confidence). A tract is **borderline** when its share for test A or test B sits so close to the 50% line that this range crosses it. The tract passes or fails the test on its estimate, but the true share could plausibly be on the other side. For example, a tract where 53% of adults have no bachelor's degree, plus or minus 5 points, passes test A, yet its range of 48% to 58% includes 50%, so it is borderline. Borderline tracts keep the class their estimates give them. The comparison tables also show results without them, to check that a finding does not rest on tracts that could have been classed either way. Test C compares two medians and has no comparable margin here, so it plays no part in the borderline flag.

```{r stage6-working-class}
# =============================================================================
# STAGE 6. WORKING-CLASS TRACTS
# Classifies each crosswalk tract, then prints the sensitivity table (tract
# counts only) before any ADU result is compared across tract classes.
# Stops the knit if: a tract has neither a class nor an "insufficient data" flag.
# =============================================================================
classify_tracts <- function(long, xw) {   # one rule for the six CPAs and citywide
  tc <- component_table(long, "GEOID") %>%
    filter(comp %in% c("pop", "ed_univ", "ed_ba", "emp_occ", "occ_wc", "emp_ind", "ind_wc")) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = comp, values_from = c(estimate, moe))
  med <- long %>% filter(variable %in% c("B19113_001", "B19013_001")) %>%
    distinct(GEOID, variable, estimate) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = estimate)
  xw %>% select(GEOID, CT20, cpa) %>%
    left_join(tc, by = c("GEOID" = "group")) %>%
    left_join(transmute(med, GEOID, mfi = B19113_001, mhi = B19013_001), by = "GEOID") %>%
    mutate(
      share_ba  = estimate_ed_ba / estimate_ed_univ,
      moe_ba    = moe_prop(estimate_ed_ba, estimate_ed_univ, moe_ed_ba, moe_ed_univ),
      share_no_ba = 1 - share_ba,
      share_occ = estimate_occ_wc / estimate_emp_occ,
      moe_occ   = moe_prop(estimate_occ_wc, estimate_emp_occ, moe_occ_wc, moe_emp_occ),
      share_ind = estimate_ind_wc / estimate_emp_ind,
      mfi_ratio = mfi / metro_mfi,
      mhi_ratio = mhi / county_mhi,
      test_A = share_no_ba >= 0.5,
      test_B = share_occ >= 0.5,
      test_C = mfi_ratio < 1,
      test_B_ind = share_ind >= 0.5,
      test_C_hh  = mhi_ratio < 1,
      insufficient    = estimate_pop < 100 | is.na(mfi),
      insufficient_hh = estimate_pop < 100 | is.na(mhi),
      borderline = (abs(share_no_ba - 0.5) <= moe_ba) | (abs(share_occ - 0.5) <= moe_occ),
      wc_rec = !insufficient & test_A & test_B & test_C,
      wc_ind = !insufficient & test_A & test_B_ind & test_C,
      wc_hh  = !insufficient_hh & test_A & test_B & test_C_hh,
      class = case_when(insufficient ~ "Insufficient data",
                        wc_rec ~ "Working-class",
                        TRUE ~ "Other"))
}
tract_class <- classify_tracts(acs_long, tract_xwalk)
qa_add(6, "Every crosswalk tract has a class or an insufficient-data flag", "317",
       sum(tract_class$class %in% c("Working-class", "Other", "Insufficient data")),
       all(tract_class$class %in% c("Working-class", "Other", "Insufficient data")) &&
         !any(is.na(tract_class$test_A[!tract_class$insufficient])) &&
         !any(is.na(tract_class$test_B[!tract_class$insufficient])), stop_if_fail = TRUE)
insuff <- tract_class %>% filter(insufficient)
qa_add(6, "Tracts with insufficient data (expected 9800.21, 2218.10, 2247.02, 2372.02)", "4",
       paste0(nrow(insuff), " (", paste(sprintf("%.2f", as.numeric(insuff$CT20) / 100), collapse = ", "), ")"),
       setequal(insuff$CT20, c("980021", "221810", "224702", "237202")))

# Citywide classification with the same rule, for the citywide map
acs_long_city <- acs_long_all %>% inner_join(select(city_xwalk, GEOID, cpa), by = "GEOID")
qa_add(6, "City tracts missing from the ACS pull", "0", length(setdiff(city_xwalk$GEOID, acs_long_city$GEOID)),
       all(city_xwalk$GEOID %in% acs_long_city$GEOID), stop_if_fail = TRUE)
tract_class_city <- classify_tracts(acs_long_city, city_xwalk)
same_cls <- tract_class %>% select(GEOID, class, test_A, test_B, test_C, borderline) %>%
  inner_join(select(tract_class_city, GEOID, class2 = class, A2 = test_A, B2 = test_B, C2 = test_C, bl2 = borderline), by = "GEOID")
qa_add(6, "Citywide classification matches the six-CPA classification tract by tract", "317 of 317",
       paste(sum(same_cls$class == same_cls$class2 & same_cls$test_A %in% same_cls$A2 & same_cls$test_B %in% same_cls$B2 &
                   same_cls$test_C %in% same_cls$C2 & same_cls$borderline %in% same_cls$bl2), "of", nrow(tract_class)),
       nrow(same_cls) == nrow(tract_class) && all(same_cls$class == same_cls$class2) &&
         identical(same_cls$test_A, same_cls$A2) && identical(same_cls$test_B, same_cls$B2) &&
         identical(same_cls$test_C, same_cls$C2) && identical(same_cls$borderline, same_cls$bl2), stop_if_fail = TRUE)
```

### Sensitivity: tract counts under the rule and two alternatives

A definition built from three tests could give a different answer if any one test were measured another way. This table checks how much the result depends on those choices. It shows **tract counts only**: the rule was fixed before any ADU result was compared across tract classes. Reading across the columns:

- **A. Education, B. Occupation, C. Family income below metro**: tracts that pass each test taken alone.
- **Working-class: A + B + C (rule used)**: tracts that pass all three, the definition used in this analysis.
- **Borderline**: tracts whose share for test A or B is within its margin of error of 50%.
- **Alt. B: industry**: an alternative way to measure test B. It counts workers by the industry they work in (construction, manufacturing, trade, transportation, hospitality and other services) in place of the occupation they hold. **Working-class with industry B** is the number of tracts classed working-class if this measure replaces test B.
- **Alt. C: household income below county**: an alternative way to measure test C. It compares the tract's median household income with the Los Angeles County median, in place of median family income with the metro median. **Working-class with household-income C** is the number of tracts classed working-class if this measure replaces test C.

If the three "working-class" columns were close, the choice of measure would matter little. Where they differ, the definition is sensitive to that choice in that CPA.

```{r stage6-sensitivity}
sens <- tract_class %>%
  mutate(cpa = factor(cpa, levels = focus_cpas)) %>%
  group_by(cpa) %>%
  summarise(Tracts = n(),
            `Insufficient data` = sum(insufficient),
            `A. Education` = sum(test_A & !insufficient, na.rm = TRUE),
            `B. Occupation` = sum(test_B & !insufficient, na.rm = TRUE),
            `C. Family income below metro` = sum(test_C & !insufficient, na.rm = TRUE),
            `Working-class: A + B + C (rule used)` = sum(wc_rec, na.rm = TRUE),
            `Borderline (A or B interval includes 50%)` = sum(borderline & !insufficient, na.rm = TRUE),
            `Alt. B: industry` = sum(test_B_ind & !insufficient, na.rm = TRUE),
            `Working-class with industry B` = sum(wc_ind, na.rm = TRUE),
            `Alt. C: household income below county` = sum(test_C_hh & !insufficient_hh, na.rm = TRUE),
            `Working-class with household-income C` = sum(wc_hh, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")
sens_total <- sens %>% summarise(across(-cpa, sum)) %>% mutate(cpa = "All six CPAs")
bind_rows(mutate(sens, cpa = as.character(cpa)), sens_total) %>%
  rename(CPA = cpa) %>%
  tbl(caption = "Census tracts passing each working-class test, alone and together (census tracts)",
      note = paste0("ACS 2020–2024 5-year. A: B15003_001, _022–_025. B: DP03_0026, DP03_0028–_0031. ",
                    "C: B19113_001, tract ÷ Los Angeles–Long Beach–Anaheim metro ($", fmt(metro_mfi), "). ",
                    "Alt. B: DP03_0033–_0038, _0043, _0044 ÷ DP03_0032. ",
                    "Alt. C: B19013_001, tract ÷ Los Angeles County ($", fmt(county_mhi), "). ",
                    "Test counts exclude tracts with insufficient data (under 100 residents or no published median)."))
```

`r sum(tract_class$wc_rec)` of `r nrow(tract_class) - sum(tract_class$insufficient)` classifiable tracts pass all three tests, and `r sum(tract_class$borderline & !tract_class$insufficient, na.rm = TRUE)` are borderline on test A or B. Four tracts have no published median family income in the 2020–2024 file and get no class: `r paste(sprintf("%.2f", as.numeric(insuff$CT20) / 100), collapse = ", ")`.

```{r stage7-prep}
# =============================================================================
# STAGE 7 (part 1). SHARED OBJECTS FOR THE CITYWIDE AND CPA SECTIONS
# Every number below is built from the stage 1-6 objects; nothing is typed in.
# =============================================================================
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(leaflet); library(htmltools); library(htmlwidgets); library(plotly) })
lab_cpa <- function(x) x                                     # CPA names print as NAME_ALF
short_cpa <- c("Arleta - Pacoima" = "Arleta - Pacoima", "West Adams - Baldwin Hills - Leimert" = "West Adams",
               "South Los Angeles" = "South LA", "Southeast Los Angeles" = "Southeast LA",
               "Northeast Los Angeles" = "Northeast LA", "Boyle Heights" = "Boyle Heights")
status_levels <- names(pal_status)
yr_end <- function(y) pmin(as.Date(paste0(y, "-12-31")), data_asof)

# ---- Eligibility flags on the six-CPA parcels ---------------------------------
prop_sf <- prop_sf %>%
  mutate(is_sf = land_use == "Single-family",
         is_mf = str_starts(land_use, "Multi-family"),
         sfA = is_sf & lot_sqft >= 4500,            # row 3: eligible single-family, tier A
         sfB_helper = is_sf & !hillside_fire,       # row 4: computed, not displayed
         sfB = sfA & sfB_helper,                    # row 5: eligible single-family, tier B
         mfA = is_mf & lot_sqft >= 4500,            # row 6: eligible multi-family, tier A (same 4,500 sq ft floor)
         mfB = mfA & !hillside_fire,                # row 7: eligible multi-family, tier B
         eligA = sfA | mfA, eligB = sfB | mfB)

# ---- ADU projects with location, status and screen flags ---------------------
adu <- adu %>%
  mutate(status = factor(as.character(status), levels = status_levels),
         outside_A_sf = property_type == "Single-family" & !is.na(lot_sqft) & lot_sqft < 4500,   # single-family only: kept for the earlier-run check
         outside_B_sf = outside_A_sf | coalesce(hillside_fire, FALSE),
         outside_A = property_type %in% c("Single-family", "Multi-family") & !is.na(lot_sqft) & lot_sqft < 4500,
         outside_B = outside_A | coalesce(hillside_fire, FALSE))
adu_xy <- adu %>%
  mutate(x = pt_x, y = pt_y)
need_ll <- is.na(adu_xy$x) & !is.na(adu_xy$lat) & adu_xy$lat != 0
if (any(need_ll)) {
  ll <- st_as_sf(adu_xy[need_ll, c("lon", "lat")], coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = crs_web) %>%
    st_transform(crs_ft) %>% st_coordinates()
  adu_xy$x[need_ll] <- ll[, 1]; adu_xy$y[need_ll] <- ll[, 2]
}
adu_pts <- adu_xy %>% filter(!is.na(x), !is.na(y)) %>% st_as_sf(coords = c("x", "y"), crs = crs_ft, remove = FALSE)
adu_focus <- adu %>% filter(cpa %in% focus_cpas)

# ---- Summaries reused by the CPA sections and the selection section ----------
land_summary <- function(cc) {
  d <- st_drop_geometry(prop_sf) %>% filter(cpa == cc)
  tibble(cpa = cc, area_sqft = cpa_sf$area_sqft[cpa_sf$cpa == cc],
         r1 = nrow(d), r2 = sum(d$is_sf), r3 = sum(d$sfA), r4 = sum(d$sfB_helper), r5 = sum(d$sfB),
         r_mf = sum(d$is_mf), r6 = sum(d$mfA), r6a = sum(d$land_use == "Multi-family, 2-4 units"),
         r6b = sum(d$land_use == "Multi-family, 5+ units"), r7 = sum(d$mfB),
         r8 = sum(d$eligA), r9 = sum(d$eligB), older = sum(d$older_adu, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    mutate(r10 = r8 - r9)
}
adu_summary <- function(d) {
  tibble(projects = nrow(d), units = sum(d$units),
         completed = sum(d$units[d$status == "Completed"]),
         in_progress = sum(d$units[d$status == "In progress"]),
         stalled = sum(d$units[d$status == "Stalled"]),
         outside_A = sum(d$units[d$outside_A]), outside_B = sum(d$units[d$outside_B]),
         properties = n_distinct(d$prop_id[!is.na(d$prop_id)]) + sum(is.na(d$prop_id)),
         prop_sf = n_distinct(d$prop_id[d$property_type == "Single-family"]),
         prop_mf = n_distinct(d$prop_id[d$property_type == "Multi-family" & !is.na(d$prop_id)]) +
           sum(d$property_type == "Multi-family" & is.na(d$prop_id)),
         units_sf = sum(d$units[d$property_type == "Single-family"]),
         units_mf = sum(d$units[d$property_type == "Multi-family"]))
}
land_tbl <- map_dfr(focus_cpas, land_summary)
adu_tbl  <- map_dfr(focus_cpas, function(cc) adu_summary(filter(adu_focus, cpa == cc)) %>% mutate(cpa = cc))

# ---- Map helpers --------------------------------------------------------------
bm_for <- function(geom_ft, tiles = 4) {
  bb <- st_bbox(st_transform(geom_ft, crs_web))
  light_basemap(bb, zoom = zoom_for(bb, tiles = tiles))
}
leaflet_base <- function(height = 560, bm_key = NULL) {
  m <- leaflet(height = height, options = leafletOptions(preferCanvas = TRUE, zoomSnap = 0.25, zoomDelta = 0.5)) %>%
    addProviderTiles("Esri.WorldGrayCanvas") %>%
    addTiles(urlTemplate = "https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/Canvas/World_Light_Gray_Reference/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}",
             attribution = "Esri, HERE, Garmin, (c) OpenStreetMap contributors")
  if (!is.null(bm_key)) m <- add_bm(m, bm_key)
  m
}
# ---- Embedded basemap under every web map ------------------------------------
# The web maps load the Esri tiles over the internet. Where a viewer blocks
# outside images, or the page is opened offline, the tiles never arrive, so each
# web map also carries the same Esri basemap (base plus labels, built from the
# cached tiles like the static maps) as one image under the live tiles. The live
# tiles cover it when they load; failed tiles stay hidden, so it shows through.
merc2ll <- function(x, y) c(lng = x / 6378137 * 180 / pi, lat = (2 * atan(exp(y / 6378137)) - pi / 2) * 180 / pi)
bm_embed <- function(geom_ft, tiles, quality = 0.8) {
  bb <- st_bbox(st_transform(geom_ft, crs_web))
  bm <- light_basemap(bb, zoom = zoom_for(bb, tiles = tiles))
  f <- tempfile(fileext = ".jpg"); jpeg::writeJPEG(bm$img, f, quality = quality)
  sw <- merc2ll(bm$ext[["xmin"]], bm$ext[["ymin"]]); ne <- merc2ll(bm$ext[["xmax"]], bm$ext[["ymax"]])
  list(url = paste0("data:image/jpeg;base64,", base64enc::base64encode(f)),
       bounds = list(c(sw[["lat"]], sw[["lng"]]), c(ne[["lat"]], ne[["lng"]])),
       px = dim(bm$img)[2:1], blank = mean(bm$img) > 0.999)
}
cpa_key <- function(cc) gsub("[^a-z]", "", tolower(cc))
bm_store <- list(city = bm_embed(st_buffer(st_union(cpa_sf), 10560), tiles = 8))
for (cc in focus_cpas) {
  frame_cc <- st_union(c(st_geometry(filter(cpa_sf, cpa == cc)),
                         st_geometry(filter(tracts_sf, CT20 %in% tract_xwalk$CT20[tract_xwalk$cpa == cc]))))
  bm_store[[cpa_key(cc)]] <- bm_embed(st_buffer(frame_cc, 5280), tiles = 5)
}
n_blank <- sum(vapply(bm_store, `[[`, TRUE, "blank"))
qa_add(7, "Embedded basemap images built for the City and the six CPAs (none blank)", "0 blank",
       paste(n_blank, "blank"), n_blank == 0,
       reason = if (n_blank > 0) "The Esri tiles could not be fetched when the report was knit (offline?). The web maps still show the live tiles when the page is opened online." else NA_character_)
add_bm <- function(m, key) {
  onRender(m, "
    function(el, x, data) {
      var b = window.aduBasemaps && window.aduBasemaps[data.key];
      if (!b) return;
      var map = this;
      if (!map.getPane('bmEmbed')) {
        var p = map.createPane('bmEmbed'); p.style.zIndex = 150; p.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
      }
      L.imageOverlay(b.url, b.bounds, {pane: 'bmEmbed', interactive: false}).addTo(map);
    }", data = list(key = key))
}
fit_to <- function(m, geom_ft) {    # open the map on the CPA
  b <- st_bbox(st_transform(geom_ft, crs_web))
  fitBounds(m, b[["xmin"]], b[["ymin"]], b[["xmax"]], b[["ymax"]])
}
label_style <- list("font-size" = "11px", "font-weight" = "bold", "color" = "#222222",
                    "text-shadow" = "0 0 3px #FFFFFF, 0 0 3px #FFFFFF, 0 0 2px #FFFFFF")
to_ll <- function(x, digits = 6) {   # web-map geometry with rounded coordinates (6 decimals ~ 10 cm; 5 ~ 1 m) to keep the page small
  x <- st_transform(x, crs_web)
  st_geometry(x) <- st_as_sfc(st_as_binary(st_geometry(x), precision = 10^digits), crs = crs_web)
  x
}
hatch_lines <- function(poly, n = 70) {           # diagonal hatching clipped to a polygon
  if (length(poly) == 0 || all(st_is_empty(poly))) return(st_sfc(crs = st_crs(poly)))
  bb <- st_bbox(poly); w <- bb[["xmax"]] - bb[["xmin"]]; h <- bb[["ymax"]] - bb[["ymin"]]
  step <- max(w, h) / n
  offs <- seq(-h, w, by = step)
  lines <- lapply(offs, function(o) st_linestring(rbind(c(bb[["xmin"]] + o, bb[["ymin"]]),
                                                        c(bb[["xmin"]] + o + h, bb[["ymax"]]))))
  st_intersection(st_sfc(lines, crs = st_crs(poly)), st_union(poly))
}
# ---- Working-class hover: the three test values, each marked pass or fail -----
wc_cols <- c("Working-class" = "#C2662D", "Other" = "#6BAED6", "Insufficient data" = "#D9D9D9")
wc_pal <- function(x) unname(wc_cols[x])
mark <- function(ok) ifelse(is.na(ok), "",
                            ifelse(ok, "<span style='color:#1a7f37;font-weight:bold'>&#10003; pass</span>",
                                   "<span style='color:#C0392B;font-weight:bold'>&#10007; fail</span>"))
fails_txt <- function(d) {
  nm <- c(A = "A (education)", B = "B (occupation)", C = "C (income)")
  f <- cbind(A = !d$test_A, B = !d$test_B, C = !d$test_C)
  apply(f, 1, function(r) { x <- nm[names(r)[r %in% TRUE]]
    if (length(x) <= 1) paste(x, collapse = "") else paste(paste(head(x, -1), collapse = ", "), "and", tail(x, 1)) })
}
wc_hover <- function(d, cls = d$class, cpa_name = NULL) {
  few <- (d$estimate_pop < 100) %in% TRUE | is.na(d$estimate_pop)   # values from under 100 residents are not shown
  a <- ifelse(few, NA, d$share_no_ba); am <- ifelse(few, NA, d$moe_ba)
  b <- ifelse(few, NA, d$share_occ);   bm <- ifelse(few, NA, d$moe_occ)
  p1 <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "n/a", paste0(fmt(100 * x, 1), "%"))
  pm <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "", paste0(" &plusmn; ", fmt(100 * x, 1), " pts"))
  status <- case_when(
    cls == "Insufficient data" ~ paste0("<b>No class</b>: ", ifelse(few, "under 100 residents", "no published median family income")),
    cls == "Working-class" ~ "<b>Working-class</b>: passes A, B and C",
    TRUE ~ paste0("<b>Other (not working-class)</b>: fails ", fails_txt(d)))
  bl <- ifelse(cls != "Insufficient data" & d$borderline %in% TRUE,
               "<br><i>Borderline: the 90% interval for A or B includes 50%</i>", "")
  paste0("<b>Tract ", d$LABEL, "</b>", if (!is.null(cpa_name)) paste0(" &middot; ", cpa_name) else "", "<br>", status, bl,
         "<br><b>A. Adults 25+ with no bachelor's degree</b><br>", p1(a), pm(am), " &middot; needs 50% or more &middot; ",
         mark(ifelse(few, NA, d$test_A)),
         "<br><b>B. Workers in service, sales and office, construction,</b><br><b>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;production or transport jobs</b><br>",
         p1(b), pm(bm), " &middot; needs 50% or more &middot; ", mark(ifelse(few, NA, d$test_B)),
         "<br><b>C. Median family income &divide; metro median</b><br>",
         ifelse(is.na(d$mfi), "not published",
                paste0("$", fmt(d$mfi), " &divide; $", fmt(metro_mfi), " = ", fmt(d$mfi_ratio, 2))),
         " &middot; needs under 1.00 &middot; ", mark(d$test_C))
}
```

# Citywide

The citywide section covers every Community Plan Area. Each project is assigned to the CPA of its parcel (APN, then City PIN, then coordinates), and to the permit's CPA text only when no parcel is found. `r fmt(nrow(adu))` ADU projects adding `r fmt(sum(adu$units))` units were issued from `r window_label`.

## ADU units by year and status

```{r c1-yearly}
c1 <- adu %>%
  group_by(issue_year) %>%
  summarise(projects = n(),
            completed = sum(units[status == "Completed"]),
            in_progress = sum(units[status == "In progress"]),
            stalled = sum(units[status == "Stalled"]),
            units = sum(units), .groups = "drop") %>%   # total last: it would mask the column above
  mutate(share = completed / units)
c1_tot <- c1 %>% summarise(across(c(projects, units, completed, in_progress, stalled), sum)) %>%
  mutate(issue_year = NA, share = completed / units)
qa_add(7, "C1: completed + in progress + stalled = units, every year", "all years", "checked",
       all(c1$completed + c1$in_progress + c1$stalled == c1$units), stop_if_fail = TRUE)
bind_rows(c1, c1_tot) %>%
  transmute(`Issue year` = case_when(is.na(issue_year) ~ "Total",
                                     issue_year == year(data_asof) ~ paste0(issue_year, " (to ", format(data_asof, "%b %e") %>% str_squish(), ")"),
                                     TRUE ~ as.character(issue_year)),
            `ADU projects` = fmt(projects), `ADU units` = fmt(units), Completed = fmt(completed),
            `In progress` = fmt(in_progress), Stalled = fmt(stalled), `Share completed` = pct(share)) %>%
  tbl(caption = "ADU projects and units by issue year, with units by status, citywide (ADU projects; ADU units)",
      note = paste0("Year of the project's first ADU-flagged permit. Status: completed = CofO, final inspection or CofC anywhere in the permit chain; stalled = no permit status change since ",
                    format(stall_cutoff, "%B %e, %Y") %>% str_squish(), ". ", window_label, "; ", year(data_asof), " is a partial year."))
```

## CPA rankings

The first table ranks every CPA in the City on cumulative ADU units; the two tables after it follow the six candidate CPAs year by year.

```{r c2-rankings}
not_ranked <- c("Port of Los Angeles", "Los Angeles International Airport")
sf_den <- parcel_class %>% filter(land_use == "Single-family") %>% count(cpa, name = "sf_parcels")
rank_base <- adu %>%
  filter(cpa %in% setdiff(cpa_sf$cpa, not_ranked)) %>%
  count(cpa, issue_year, wt = units, name = "units") %>%
  complete(cpa = setdiff(cpa_sf$cpa, not_ranked), issue_year = 2017:year(data_asof), fill = list(units = 0))
n_ranked <- n_distinct(rank_base$cpa)
annual <- rank_base %>% group_by(issue_year) %>% mutate(rank_n = min_rank(desc(units))) %>% ungroup()
cumul <- rank_base %>% arrange(issue_year) %>% group_by(cpa) %>% mutate(cum_units = cumsum(units)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  left_join(sf_den, by = "cpa") %>%
  mutate(per100 = 100 * cum_units / sf_parcels) %>%
  group_by(issue_year) %>% mutate(rank_pct = min_rank(desc(per100))) %>% ungroup()
band_bg <- function(r) case_when(r <= 5 ~ "#1F3864", r <= 10 ~ "#2E75B6", r <= 17 ~ "#BDD7EE", TRUE ~ "#E7E6E6")
band_fg <- function(r) if_else(r <= 10, "white", "black")
rank_cells <- function(df, value_fmt, rank_col, val_col) {
  df %>%
    mutate(cell = cell_spec(paste0("#", .data[[rank_col]], " (", value_fmt(.data[[val_col]]), ")"),
                            background = band_bg(.data[[rank_col]]), color = band_fg(.data[[rank_col]]), bold = TRUE)) %>%
    select(cpa, issue_year, cell) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = issue_year, values_from = cell) %>%
    arrange(match(cpa, focus_cpas)) %>% rename(CPA = cpa)
}
legend_note <- paste0("Cell = rank among ", n_ranked, " CPAs (value). Shading: dark blue = top 5, medium blue = 6-10, light blue = 11-17, grey = 18-", n_ranked,
                      ". Port of Los Angeles and Los Angeles International Airport are not ranked.")
standings <- cumul %>% filter(issue_year == year(data_asof)) %>%
  mutate(rank_units = min_rank(desc(cum_units))) %>% arrange(rank_pct)
standings %>%
  transmute(`Rank (per 100 SF parcels)` = rank_pct, CPA = cpa, `ADU units` = fmt(cum_units),
            `Single-family parcels` = fmt(sf_parcels), `Units per 100 SF parcels` = fmt(per100, 1),
            `Rank (units)` = rank_units) %>%
  kable(format = "html", align = c("c", "l", "r", "r", "r", "c"),
        caption = paste0("Cumulative standings, all CPAs, ", window_label, " (ADU units; parcels)")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("condensed", "striped"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
  row_spec(which(standings$cpa %in% focus_cpas), bold = TRUE, background = "#FFF2CC") %>%
  footnote(general = "Six candidate CPAs highlighted. Ranks shift slightly from the earlier report because projects are now placed by parcel location and the stalled cutoff includes exactly three years.",
           general_title = "Note: ", footnote_as_chunk = TRUE)
annual %>% filter(cpa %in% focus_cpas) %>% rank_cells(fmt, "rank_n", "units") %>%
  kable(format = "html", escape = FALSE, caption = "Rank by ADU units permitted each year, six candidate CPAs (ADU units)") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "condensed", full_width = FALSE) %>%
  footnote(general = legend_note, general_title = "Note: ", footnote_as_chunk = TRUE)
cumul %>% filter(cpa %in% focus_cpas) %>% rank_cells(function(v) fmt(v, 1), "rank_pct", "per100") %>%
  kable(format = "html", escape = FALSE, caption = "Rank by cumulative ADU units per 100 single-family parcels, through each year, six candidate CPAs") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "condensed", full_width = FALSE) %>%
  footnote(general = paste(legend_note, "Denominator: parcels typed SFR in the 2026 Assessor roll, assigned to CPAs by interior point. The numerator includes ADUs on multi-family parcels."),
           general_title = "Note: ", footnote_as_chunk = TRUE)
```

## ADU units by CPA, mapped

Counts follow CPA size, so the map also offers two relative measures: each CPA's share of the City's ADU units, and its units per 100 single-family parcels.

```{r c3-prep}
cpa_map_sf <- cpa_sf %>% filter(!cpa %in% not_ranked)
cum_by_cpa <- adu %>% filter(cpa %in% cpa_map_sf$cpa) %>% group_by(cpa) %>%
  summarise(all_u = sum(units), comp_u = sum(units[status == "Completed"]), .groups = "drop")
cpa_join <- cpa_map_sf %>% left_join(cum_by_cpa, by = "cpa") %>% mutate(across(c(all_u, comp_u), ~ replace_na(.x, 0)))
```

```{r c3-shares}
city_units <- sum(adu$units); city_comp <- sum(adu$units[adu$status == "Completed"])
c3s <- cpa_join %>% left_join(sf_den, by = "cpa") %>%
  mutate(sh_all = all_u / city_units, sh_comp = comp_u / city_comp,
         p100_all = 100 * all_u / sf_parcels, p100_comp = 100 * comp_u / sf_parcels,
         done = ifelse(all_u > 0, comp_u / all_u, NA_real_))
chk_p100 <- c3s %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% select(cpa, p100_all) %>%
  inner_join(select(standings, cpa, per100), by = "cpa")
qa_add(7, "C3 share map: units per 100 single-family parcels match the C2 standings, every CPA",
       paste(nrow(c3s), "CPAs"), paste(sum(abs(chk_p100$p100_all - chk_p100$per100) < 1e-9), "match"),
       nrow(chk_p100) == nrow(c3s) && all(abs(chk_p100$p100_all - chk_p100$per100) < 1e-9), stop_if_fail = TRUE)
qa_add(7, "C3 share map: CPA shares of City units sum to at most 100%", "<= 100%",
       pct(sum(c3s$sh_all)), sum(c3s$sh_all) <= 1 + 1e-9 && sum(c3s$sh_comp) <= 1 + 1e-9, stop_if_fail = TRUE)
nice_brks <- function(v, step) {      # six bins from quantiles, rounded to a readable step
  q <- unique(round(quantile(v, probs = seq(1/6, 5/6, length.out = 5), na.rm = TRUE) / step) * step)
  unique(c(0, q[q > 0], ceiling(max(v, na.rm = TRUE) / step) * step))
}
brk_n <- nice_brks(c(c3s$all_u, c3s$comp_u), 50)
pal_n <- colorBin("Greens", domain = range(brk_n), bins = brk_n, na.color = "#D9D9D9")
brk_sh <- nice_brks(c(c3s$sh_all, c3s$sh_comp), 0.005)
brk_100 <- nice_brks(c(c3s$p100_all, c3s$p100_comp), 1)
pal_sh <- colorBin("Blues", domain = range(brk_sh), bins = brk_sh, na.color = "#D9D9D9")
pal_100 <- colorBin("Purples", domain = range(brk_100), bins = brk_100, na.color = "#D9D9D9")
c3_ll <- c3s %>% st_simplify(preserveTopology = TRUE, dTolerance = 50) %>% to_ll(digits = 5)
cols_c3 <- list(n_all = setNames(pal_n(c3_ll$all_u), c3_ll$cpa), n_comp = setNames(pal_n(c3_ll$comp_u), c3_ll$cpa),
                sh_all = setNames(pal_sh(c3_ll$sh_all), c3_ll$cpa), sh_comp = setNames(pal_sh(c3_ll$sh_comp), c3_ll$cpa),
                p100_all = setNames(pal_100(c3_ll$p100_all), c3_ll$cpa), p100_comp = setNames(pal_100(c3_ll$p100_comp), c3_ll$cpa))
rk <- function(x) min_rank(desc(x))
lab_c3 <- sprintf(paste0("<b>%s</b><br>ADU units: %s, %s of the City's (rank %d of %d)<br>",
                         "Completed units: %s, %s of the City's completed (rank %d)<br>",
                         "Share of its own units completed: %s<br>",
                         "Units per 100 single-family parcels: %s all, %s completed (rank %d)<br>Single-family parcels: %s"),
                  c3_ll$cpa, fmt(c3_ll$all_u), pct(c3_ll$sh_all), rk(c3_ll$sh_all), nrow(c3_ll),
                  fmt(c3_ll$comp_u), pct(c3_ll$sh_comp), rk(c3_ll$sh_comp), pct(c3_ll$done),
                  fmt(c3_ll$p100_all, 1), fmt(c3_ll$p100_comp, 1), rk(c3_ll$p100_all), fmt(c3_ll$sf_parcels))
pct_fmt <- labelFormat(suffix = "%", transform = function(x) round(100 * x, 1))
m_c3 <- leaflet_base(height = 620, bm_key = "city") %>% fit_to(cpa_map_sf) %>%
  addPolygons(data = c3_ll, layerId = ~cpa, fillColor = unname(cols_c3$n_all), fillOpacity = 0.75,
              color = "white", weight = 1, label = lapply(lab_c3, HTML), group = "c3") %>%
  addPolygons(data = to_ll(filter(cpa_map_sf, cpa %in% focus_cpas), digits = 5), fill = FALSE, color = "black", weight = 2.2,
              options = pathOptions(interactive = FALSE)) %>%   # outline only: hover reaches the layer below
  addLegend("bottomright", pal = pal_n, values = brk_n, title = "ADU units", opacity = 0.8,
            className = "info legend leg-n") %>%
  addLegend("bottomright", pal = pal_sh, values = brk_sh, title = "Share of the City's<br>ADU units", opacity = 0.8,
            labFormat = pct_fmt, className = "info legend leg-sh") %>%
  addLegend("bottomright", pal = pal_100, values = brk_100, title = "ADU units per 100<br>single-family parcels", opacity = 0.8,
            className = "info legend leg-p100") %>%
  onRender("
    function(el, x, data) {
      var map = this, nm = el.id;
      var ctrl = L.control({position: 'topright'});
      ctrl.onAdd = function() {
        var div = L.DomUtil.create('div', 'leaflet-bar');
        div.style.background = 'white'; div.style.padding = '6px 8px'; div.style.fontSize = '12px';
        div.innerHTML = '<b>Units</b><br>' +
          '<label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"' + nm + '_u\" value=\"all\" checked> All ADU units</label><br>' +
          '<label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"' + nm + '_u\" value=\"comp\"> Completed ADU units</label><br>' +
          '<b>Measure</b><br>' +
          '<label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"' + nm + '_m\" value=\"n\" checked> Counts of ADU units</label><br>' +
          '<label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"' + nm + '_m\" value=\"sh\"> Share of the City&#39;s units</label><br>' +
          '<label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"' + nm + '_m\" value=\"p100\"> Per 100 single-family parcels</label>';
        L.DomEvent.disableClickPropagation(div);
        return div;
      };
      ctrl.addTo(map);
      function update() {
        var u = el.querySelector('input[name=\"' + nm + '_u\"]:checked').value;
        var ms = el.querySelector('input[name=\"' + nm + '_m\"]:checked').value;
        var cols = data.cols[ms + '_' + u];
        Object.keys(cols).forEach(function(id) {
          var l = map.layerManager.getLayer('shape', id);
          if (l) l.setStyle({fillColor: cols[id]});
        });
        el.querySelectorAll('.leg-n').forEach(function(d) { d.style.display = ms === 'n' ? '' : 'none'; });
        el.querySelectorAll('.leg-sh').forEach(function(d) { d.style.display = ms === 'sh' ? '' : 'none'; });
        el.querySelectorAll('.leg-p100').forEach(function(d) { d.style.display = ms === 'p100' ? '' : 'none'; });
      }
      el.addEventListener('change', update);
      update();
    }", data = list(cols = cols_c3))
qa_add(7, "C3 map: unit counts on the map sum to the mapped CPAs' units", fmt(sum(cum_by_cpa$all_u)), fmt(sum(c3s$all_u)),
       sum(c3s$all_u) == sum(cum_by_cpa$all_u) && sum(c3s$comp_u) == sum(cum_by_cpa$comp_u), stop_if_fail = TRUE)
tagList(tags$p(tags$b(paste0("ADU units by Community Plan Area, ", window_label))),
        m_c3,
        tags$p(style = "font-size: 12px;",
               paste0("Use the controls to switch between all and completed units, and between three measures: counts of ADU units, each CPA's share of the City's units, and units per 100 single-family parcels. Six candidate CPAs outlined in black; hover for every measure and rank. ",
                      "Shares are of all ", fmt(city_units), " ADU units (", fmt(city_comp), " completed) permitted citywide; Port of Los Angeles and Los Angeles International Airport are not mapped. ",
                      "Per 100 single-family parcels uses the same denominator as the CPA rankings: parcels typed SFR in the 2026 Assessor roll, assigned by interior point; the numerator includes ADUs on multi-family parcels. ",
                      "Completed = CofO, final inspection or CofC in the permit chain. Shared bins for all and completed units within each measure. ", basemap_credit, ".")))
```

## ADU projects by issue year, mapped

```{r c4-year-slider}
# One point per project, drawn by issue year with a slider (cumulative or single year).
c4_years <- 2017:year(data_asof)
p4 <- adu_pts %>% filter(cpa %in% cpa_sf$cpa, issue_year %in% c4_years) %>% st_transform(crs_web)
xy4 <- st_coordinates(p4)
c4_data <- list(lat = round(xy4[, 2], 5), lng = round(xy4[, 1], 5),
                yr = as.integer(p4$issue_year - min(c4_years)), st = as.integer(p4$status) - 1L, u = as.numeric(p4$units),
                years = c4_years, cols = unname(pal_status), stat = names(pal_status),
                last_label = paste0(year(data_asof), " (to ", str_squish(format(data_asof, "%b %e")), ")"))
n_nopt <- nrow(adu) - nrow(p4)
qa_add(7, "C4 slider map: mapped projects + projects without a point = all projects", fmt(nrow(adu)),
       fmt(nrow(p4) + n_nopt), nrow(p4) > 0 && n_nopt >= 0 && !anyNA(c4_data$st) && !anyNA(c4_data$yr), stop_if_fail = TRUE)
c4_chk <- st_drop_geometry(p4) %>% count(issue_year, wt = units, name = "u") %>%
  inner_join(c1 %>% select(issue_year, units), by = "issue_year")
qa_add(7, "C4 slider map: units by issue year do not exceed the C1 table in any year", "all years",
       paste(sum(c4_chk$u <= c4_chk$units), "of", nrow(c4_chk)), all(c4_chk$u <= c4_chk$units), stop_if_fail = TRUE)
m_c4 <- leaflet_base(height = 640, bm_key = "city") %>% fit_to(cpa_map_sf) %>%
  addPolygons(data = to_ll(st_simplify(cpa_sf, preserveTopology = TRUE, dTolerance = 50), digits = 5),
              fillColor = "#FFFFFF", fillOpacity = 0.01, color = "#555555", weight = 0.7, label = ~cpa) %>%
  addPolygons(data = to_ll(filter(cpa_sf, cpa %in% focus_cpas), digits = 5), fill = FALSE, color = "black", weight = 2,
              options = pathOptions(interactive = FALSE)) %>%
  addLegend("bottomright", colors = unname(pal_status), labels = names(pal_status), title = "Status", opacity = 0.9) %>%
  onRender("
    function(el, x, data) {
      var map = this, nm = el.id, n = data.lat.length, yrs = data.years, last = yrs.length - 1;
      var groups = yrs.map(function() { return L.layerGroup(); });
      for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        L.circleMarker([data.lat[i], data.lng[i]], {radius: 1.7, stroke: false, fillColor: data.cols[data.st[i]],
                                                    fillOpacity: 0.75, interactive: false}).addTo(groups[data.yr[i]]);
      }
      var ctrl = L.control({position: 'topright'});
      ctrl.onAdd = function() {
        var div = L.DomUtil.create('div', 'leaflet-bar');
        div.style.background = 'white'; div.style.padding = '6px 8px'; div.style.fontSize = '12px'; div.style.width = '250px';
        div.innerHTML = '<b>Issue year: <span class=\"c4-yr\"></span></b><br>' +
          '<input type=\"range\" class=\"c4-slider\" min=\"0\" max=\"' + last + '\" value=\"' + last + '\" step=\"1\" style=\"width: 100%;\">' +
          '<label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"' + nm + '_mode\" value=\"cum\" checked> Through this year (cumulative)</label><br>' +
          '<label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"' + nm + '_mode\" value=\"one\"> Issued in this year only</label><br>' +
          '<button type=\"button\" class=\"c4-play\" style=\"margin: 4px 0;\">&#9654; Play</button>' +
          '<div class=\"c4-count\" style=\"margin-top: 2px;\"></div>';
        L.DomEvent.disableClickPropagation(div); L.DomEvent.disableScrollPropagation(div);
        return div;
      };
      ctrl.addTo(map);
      var slider = el.querySelector('.c4-slider'), timer = null;
      function num(v) { return v.toLocaleString('en-US'); }
      function update() {
        var k = +slider.value;
        var cum = el.querySelector('input[name=\"' + nm + '_mode\"]:checked').value === 'cum';
        groups.forEach(function(g, j) {
          var on = cum ? j <= k : j === k;
          if (on) { if (!map.hasLayer(g)) map.addLayer(g); } else if (map.hasLayer(g)) map.removeLayer(g);
        });
        var p = 0, u = 0, s = [0, 0, 0];
        for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
          var j = data.yr[i];
          if (cum ? j <= k : j === k) { p++; u += data.u[i]; s[data.st[i]] += data.u[i]; }
        }
        var lab = k === last ? data.last_label : String(yrs[k]);
        el.querySelector('.c4-yr').textContent = (cum ? '2017 through ' : '') + lab;
        el.querySelector('.c4-count').innerHTML = num(p) + ' projects, ' + num(u) + ' ADU units<br>' +
          data.stat.map(function(t, q) { return t + ': ' + num(s[q]); }).join(' &middot; ');
      }
      function stop() { if (timer) { clearInterval(timer); timer = null; el.querySelector('.c4-play').innerHTML = '&#9654; Play'; } }
      el.querySelector('.c4-play').addEventListener('click', function() {
        if (timer) { stop(); return; }
        if (+slider.value >= last) slider.value = 0; else slider.value = +slider.value + 1;
        update();
        this.innerHTML = '&#10074;&#10074; Pause';
        timer = setInterval(function() {
          if (+slider.value >= last) { stop(); return; }
          slider.value = +slider.value + 1; update();
        }, 1100);
      });
      slider.addEventListener('input', function() { stop(); update(); });
      el.addEventListener('change', update);
      update();
    }", data = c4_data)
tagList(tags$p(tags$b(paste0("ADU projects in Los Angeles by issue year, ", window_label))),
        m_c4,
        tags$p(style = "font-size: 12px;",
               paste0("Drag the slider or press Play to watch ADU projects accumulate by the year their first ADU permit was issued; switch to \"Issued in this year only\" to see one year at a time. ",
                      "One dot per project at its parcel (", fmt(nrow(p4)), " projects; ", fmt(n_nopt), " more could not be placed on the map and are not drawn). ",
                      "Color is the project's status as of ", fmt_date(data_asof), ", not its status in the year shown; the counts in the control are ADU units by that status. ",
                      "Grey lines: CPAs (hover for the name); black outline: six candidate CPAs. ", basemap_credit, ".")))
```

## Working-class census tracts, citywide

```{r c5-wc-city}
pat_levels <- c("Fails income (C) only", "Fails income and one of education or occupation",
                "Fails all three tests", "Fails education or occupation, passes income")
pat_cols <- setNames(c("#9ECAE1", "#4292C6", "#08306B", "#74C476"), pat_levels)
tc_city <- tract_class_city %>%
  mutate(pattern = case_when(class != "Other" ~ NA_character_,
                             !test_A & !test_B & !test_C ~ "Fails all three tests",
                             !test_C & test_A & test_B ~ "Fails income (C) only",
                             test_C ~ "Fails education or occupation, passes income",
                             TRUE ~ "Fails income and one of education or occupation"))
qa_add(7, "C5: every classifiable City tract has all three test results", "0 missing",
       paste(sum(tc_city$class != "Insufficient data" & (is.na(tc_city$test_A) | is.na(tc_city$test_B) | is.na(tc_city$test_C))), "missing"),
       !any(tc_city$class != "Insufficient data" & (is.na(tc_city$test_A) | is.na(tc_city$test_B) | is.na(tc_city$test_C))),
       stop_if_fail = TRUE)
qa_add(7, "C5: failure patterns cover every other tract exactly once", sum(tc_city$class == "Other"),
       sum(!is.na(tc_city$pattern)), sum(!is.na(tc_city$pattern)) == sum(tc_city$class == "Other"), stop_if_fail = TRUE)
c5_sf <- tracts_sf %>% select(CT20, LABEL) %>% inner_join(tc_city, by = "CT20") %>%

          '<label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"' + nm + '_v\" value=\"why\"> Which tests other tracts fail</label>';
        L.DomEvent.disableClickPropagation(div);
        return div;
      };
      ctrl.addTo(map);
      function update() {
        var v = el.querySelector('input[name=\"' + nm + '_v\"]:checked').value;
        var cols = data.cols[v];
        Object.keys(cols).forEach(function(id) {

        });
        el.querySelectorAll('.leg-cls').forEach(function(d) { d.style.display = v === 'cls' ? '' : 'none'; });
        el.querySelectorAll('.leg-why').forEach(function(d) { d.style.display = v === 'why' ? '' : 'none'; });
      }
      el.addEventListener('change', update);
      update();
    }", data = list(cols = cols_c5))
```

```{r c5-writeup-data}
n_city <- nrow(tc_city); n_wc_c <- sum(tc_city$class == "Working-class")
n_oth_c <- sum(tc_city$class == "Other"); n_ins_c <- sum(tc_city$class == "Insufficient data")
n_fail <- c(A = sum(tc_city$class == "Other" & !tc_city$test_A), B = sum(tc_city$class == "Other" & !tc_city$test_B),
            C = sum(tc_city$class == "Other" & !tc_city$test_C))
pat_n <- function(d, p) sum(d$pattern %in% p)
top_cpas <- function(p, k = 3) {
  tc_city %>% filter(pattern %in% p) %>% count(cpa, sort = TRUE) %>% slice_head(n = k) %>%
    summarise(txt = paste0(cpa, " (", n, ")", collapse = "; ")) %>% pull(txt)
}
six_oth <- tc_city %>% filter(cpa %in% focus_cpas, class == "Other")
n_bl_oth <- sum(tc_city$class == "Other" & tc_city$borderline %in% TRUE)
near_A <- abs(tc_city$share_no_ba - 0.5) <= tc_city$moe_ba; near_B <- abs(tc_city$share_occ - 0.5) <= tc_city$moe_occ
could_wc <- tc_city$class == "Other" & tc_city$test_C & (tc_city$test_A | near_A) & (tc_city$test_B | near_B)   # pass C; miss A or B only within the MOE
n_could <- sum(could_wc, na.rm = TRUE); n_could_six <- sum(could_wc & tc_city$cpa %in% focus_cpas, na.rm = TRUE)
n_bl_failC <- sum(tc_city$class == "Other" & tc_city$borderline %in% TRUE & !tc_city$test_C)
```

Of the `r fmt(n_city)` census tracts in the City, `r fmt(n_wc_c)` (`r pct(n_wc_c / (n_city - n_ins_c))` of those with data) are working-class, `r fmt(n_oth_c)` are other, and `r n_ins_c` have too few residents or no published median family income to classify. Of the `r fmt(n_oth_c)` other tracts, `r fmt(n_fail[["C"]])` fail the income test (median family income at or above the metro median of $`r fmt(metro_mfi)`), `r fmt(n_fail[["A"]])` fail the education test and `r fmt(n_fail[["B"]])` fail the occupation test. The tests overlap heavily: `r fmt(pat_n(tc_city, "Fails all three tests"))` other tracts fail all three. Only `r fmt(n_could)` other tracts (`r n_could_six` of them in the six candidate CPAs) pass the income test and miss A or B by no more than the margin of error, so their class could change with a different sample. More other tracts, `r fmt(n_bl_oth)`, are borderline on A or B, but `r fmt(n_bl_failC)` of them also fail the income test, so the margin of error on A or B does not change their class. In the six candidate CPAs, `r nrow(six_oth)` tracts are other: `r pat_n(six_oth, "Fails all three tests")` fail all three tests, `r pat_n(six_oth, "Fails income (C) only")` fail only the income test, `r pat_n(six_oth, "Fails income and one of education or occupation")` fail income and one other test, and `r pat_n(six_oth, "Fails education or occupation, passes income")` pass income but fail education or occupation.

```{r stage7-cpa-helpers}
# =============================================================================
# STAGE 7 (part 2). HELPERS FOR THE SIX CPA SUBSECTIONS (cpa_section.Rmd)
# =============================================================================
# ---- Dated bars, cumulative-unit charts ---------------------------------------------
dated_long <- function(d) {
  yrs <- 2017:year(data_asof)
  map_dfr(yrs, function(Y) {
    e <- yr_end(Y)
    inc <- d %>% filter(submitted <= e)
    tibble(year = Y,
           Completed = sum(inc$units[!is.na(inc$completion_dt) & inc$completion_dt <= e]),
           New = sum(inc$units[(is.na(inc$completion_dt) | inc$completion_dt > e) & year(inc$submitted) == Y]),
           Ongoing = sum(inc$units[(is.na(inc$completion_dt) | inc$completion_dt > e) & year(inc$submitted) < Y]))
  })
}
dated_chart <- function(d, title) {
  bars <- dated_long(d)
  long <- bars %>% pivot_longer(c(Completed, New, Ongoing), names_to = "segment", values_to = "units") %>%
    mutate(segment = factor(segment, levels = c("Completed", "New", "Ongoing")))
  yrs <- sort(unique(bars$year)); ymax <- max(rowSums(bars[, c("Completed", "New", "Ongoing")]), 1)
  frames <- map_dfr(yrs, function(F) long %>% filter(year <= F) %>% mutate(frame = F))
  totals <- bars %>% mutate(total = Completed + New + Ongoing, frame = year,
    label = sprintf("Through %s: %s units (completed %s, new %s, ongoing %s)",
                    ifelse(year == year(data_asof), paste0(format(data_asof, "%b %e, %Y") %>% str_squish()), year),
                    fmt(total), fmt(Completed), fmt(New), fmt(Ongoing)))
  ticktext <- ifelse(yrs == year(data_asof), paste0(yrs, "*"), as.character(yrs))
  p <- plot_ly() %>%
    add_bars(data = frames, x = ~year, y = ~units, color = ~segment, colors = pal_dated, frame = ~frame,
             hovertemplate = "%{x}: %{y:,} units<extra>%{fullData.name}</extra>") %>%
    add_text(data = totals, x = 2016.6, y = ymax * 1.1, text = ~label, frame = ~frame,
             textposition = "middle right", showlegend = FALSE, hoverinfo = "none", inherit = FALSE,
             textfont = list(size = 12)) %>%
    layout(barmode = "stack", title = list(text = title, x = 0),
           xaxis = list(title = "", tickvals = yrs, ticktext = ticktext, range = c(2016.4, max(yrs) + 0.6)),
           yaxis = list(title = "ADU units (cumulative)", range = c(0, ymax * 1.18), separatethousands = TRUE),
           legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.15)) %>%
    animation_opts(frame = 600, transition = 0, redraw = TRUE) %>%
    animation_slider(currentvalue = list(prefix = "Through ")) %>%
    animation_button(visible = FALSE) %>%
    config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
  # Open on the latest year: show the last frame's data and park the slider there
  b <- plotly_build(p)
  last <- length(b$x$frames)
  for (k in seq_along(b$x$frames[[last]]$data)) {
    tr <- b$x$frames[[last]]$data[[k]]; idx <- b$x$frames[[last]]$traces[[k]] + 1
    for (nm in names(tr)) b$x$data[[idx]][[nm]] <- tr[[nm]]
  }
  if (length(b$x$layout$sliders)) b$x$layout$sliders[[1]]$active <- last - 1
  list(widget = b, bars = bars)
}

# ---- Measures formatting (community profile, working-class demographics): estimate and MOE in separate cells ----------
fmt_est <- function(type, est, low = FALSE) {
  out <- case_when(is.na(est) ~ "n/a",
                   type == "rate" ~ paste0(fmt(100 * est, 1), "%"),
                   type == "average" ~ paste0("$", fmt(est)),
                   TRUE ~ fmt(est))
  if_else(!is.na(low) & low, paste0(out, " †"), out)
}
fmt_moe <- function(type, est, moe) {
  case_when(is.na(est) | is.na(moe) ~ "n/a",
            type == "rate" ~ paste0("± ", fmt(100 * moe, 1), " pts"),
            type == "average" ~ paste0("± $", fmt(moe)),
            TRUE ~ paste0("± ", fmt(moe)))
}
d1_order <- c("Total population", "Total households", "Owner households", "Renter households",

  "Average household income",
  "Households with poverty status", "Households below poverty", "Household poverty rate",
  "Latino households", "Latino owner households", "Latino homeownership rate", "Latino share of owner households",
  "Black households", "Black owner households", "Black homeownership rate", "Black share of owner households",
  "Non-Hispanic white households", "Non-Hispanic white owner households", "Non-Hispanic white homeownership rate", "Non-Hispanic white share of owner households",
  "Average gross rent",
  "Renter households with a computed rent burden", "Rent-burdened households", "Rent-burden rate",
  "Severely rent-burdened households", "Severe rent-burden rate",

  "Adults 25 and over", "Adults 25 and over with a bachelor's degree or higher", "Share of adults 25+ with a bachelor's degree or higher")

stopifnot(setequal(na.omit(c(d1_rows$count_key, d1_rows$share_key)), d1_order))   # every measure appears exactly once
d1_cells <- function(meas) {       # meas: one group's measures (measure, type, estimate, moe, low_reliability)
  pick <- function(key, what) {
    i <- match(key, meas$measure)
    case_when(is.na(key) ~ "—",
              what == "est" ~ fmt_est(meas$type[i], meas$estimate[i], meas$low_reliability[i]),
              TRUE ~ fmt_moe(meas$type[i], meas$estimate[i], meas$moe[i]))
  }
  tibble(Measure = d1_rows$label,
         Count = pick(d1_rows$count_key, "est"), `Count MOE` = pick(d1_rows$count_key, "moe"),
         Share = pick(d1_rows$share_key, "est"), `Share MOE` = pick(d1_rows$share_key, "moe"))
}
d1_note <- paste(
  "ACS 2020–2024 5-year estimates for the CPA's crosswalk tracts; counts summed across tracts, shares and averages recomputed from the sums. MOE = 90% margin of error (shares in percentage points, pts); † = low reliability (coefficient of variation over 30%); — = not applicable. CPA margins combine many tracts and are approximate.",
  "Count: people, households or housing units; the two averages are in dollars (average household income = aggregate household income ÷ households, 2024 dollars; average gross rent = aggregate gross rent ÷ renter units paying cash rent).",
  "Share: the row's count as a share of its base. Owner households ÷ all households (the homeownership rate); owners who moved in ÷ owner households; households below poverty ÷ households with poverty status determined; a group's owner households ÷ that group's households (the group's homeownership rate); a group's share of all owner households = its owner households ÷ all owner households; rent-burdened households ÷ renter households with a computed rent burden (rent-burdened: gross rent is 30% or more of household income; severely rent-burdened: 50% or more); adults with a bachelor's degree or higher ÷ adults 25 and over. The two vacancy rates have no single count.",
  "Black and Latino figures are reported separately and never summed. The Black table includes Black householders who are Latino, so it overlaps the Latino table slightly; the groups do not sum to all households.",
  "\"Moved in\" is the year the householder moved into the unit (B25038), not the purchase year; a 2020–2024 file understates \"2023 or later\".",
  "Averages run above medians when incomes are skewed, so CPA averages are not compared with the tract medians on the maps.",
  "Vacancy rates follow the Census Bureau's ACS Subject Definitions (Vacancy Status): vacant for sale ÷ (owner-occupied + vacant for sale + sold, not occupied); vacant for rent ÷ (renter-occupied + vacant for rent + rented, not occupied).",
  "Tables: B01003, B25038, B19025, B11001, B17017, B25003, B25003B/H/I, B25065, B25063, B25070, B25004, B15003, DP04.")

# ---- Working-class comparisons: demographics table and ADU table -------------------------------
wc_groups <- function(tc) {
  ok <- tc %>% filter(class != "Insufficient data")
  bind_rows(ok %>% transmute(GEOID, CT20, grp = paste0(class, ", all tracts")),
            ok %>% filter(!borderline) %>% transmute(GEOID, CT20, grp = paste0(class, ", without borderline")))
}
grp_levels <- c("Working-class, all tracts", "Other, all tracts", "Working-class, without borderline", "Other, without borderline")
d3_build <- function(tc) {
  g <- wc_groups(tc)
  long <- acs_long %>% select(-cpa) %>% inner_join(select(g, GEOID, grp), by = "GEOID", relationship = "many-to-many")
  meas <- if (nrow(long)) component_table(long, "grp") %>% build_measures() else tibble()
  ntr <- g %>% count(grp)
  list(meas = meas, ntr = ntr)
}
grp_note <- paste(
  "Columns: \"Working-class, all tracts\" = every tract classed working-class (tests A, B and C all pass). \"Other, all tracts\" = every tract with data that fails at least one test.",
  "\"Without borderline\" = the same two groups after dropping borderline tracts, those whose 90% interval for test A or B includes 50%, so their class could change with a different sample.",
  "Tracts with insufficient data (under 100 residents or no published median family income) get no class and are in no column.")
hl_up <- "#D9EAD3"; hl_down <- "#FFF2CC"      # working-class value above / below the other tracts' value
d3_table <- function(res, caption, note) {
  ntr <- setNames(res$ntr$n, res$ntr$grp); ntr <- coalesce(ntr[grp_levels], 0L); names(ntr) <- grp_levels
  m <- if (nrow(res$meas)) res$meas %>% filter(measure %in% d1_order) else
    tibble(group = character(), measure = character(), type = character(), estimate = numeric(), moe = numeric(), low_reliability = logical())
  cell <- function(gname, what) {
    d <- m[m$group == gname, ]; i <- match(d1_order, d$measure)
    if (ntr[[gname]] == 0) return(rep("no tracts", length(d1_order)))
    if (what == "est") fmt_est(d$type[i], d$estimate[i], d$low_reliability[i]) else fmt_moe(d$type[i], d$estimate[i], d$moe[i])
  }
  shade <- function(wc, oth) {     # rates and averages only, where the gap exceeds its 90% margin of error
    a <- m[m$group == wc, ]; b <- m[m$group == oth, ]
    ia <- match(d1_order, a$measure); ib <- match(d1_order, b$measure)
    if (ntr[[wc]] == 0 || ntr[[oth]] == 0) return(rep(NA_character_, length(d1_order)))
    diff <- a$estimate[ia] - b$estimate[ib]; me <- sqrt(a$moe[ia]^2 + b$moe[ib]^2)
    ok <- a$type[ia] %in% c("rate", "average") & is.finite(diff) & is.finite(me) & abs(diff) > me
    ifelse(ok & diff > 0, hl_up, ifelse(ok & diff < 0, hl_down, NA_character_))
  }
  out <- tibble(Measure = c("Census tracts", d1_order))
  pairs <- list(c(grp_levels[1], grp_levels[2]), c(grp_levels[3], grp_levels[4]))
  n_shaded <- 0
  for (pr in pairs) {
    sh <- shade(pr[1], pr[2]); n_shaded <- n_shaded + sum(!is.na(sh))
    est_wc <- cell(pr[1], "est")
    hit <- which(!is.na(sh))
    if (length(hit)) est_wc[hit] <- cell_spec(est_wc[hit], background = sh[hit], color = "black")
    out[[paste0(pr[1], "|est")]] <- c(fmt(ntr[[pr[1]]]), est_wc)
    out[[paste0(pr[1], "|moe")]] <- c("", cell(pr[1], "moe"))
    out[[paste0(pr[2], "|est")]] <- c(fmt(ntr[[pr[2]]]), cell(pr[2], "est"))
    out[[paste0(pr[2], "|moe")]] <- c("", cell(pr[2], "moe"))
  }
  hdr <- c(" " = 1, setNames(rep(2, 4), c(grp_levels[1], grp_levels[2], grp_levels[3], grp_levels[4])))
  kable(out, format = "html", escape = FALSE, caption = caption,
        col.names = c("Measure", rep(c("Estimate", "MOE"), 4)), align = c("l", rep("r", 8))) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE, font_size = 12) %>%
    add_header_above(hdr) %>%
    footnote(general = paste(note, grp_note,
                             "Shading in the working-class columns marks shares and averages where working-class tracts differ from the other tracts in the same pair by more than the 90% margin of error of the difference: green = working-class tracts are higher, yellow = lower. Counts are not shaded, because they follow the number of tracts in each group."),
             general_title = "Note: ", footnote_as_chunk = TRUE, threeparttable = TRUE)
}
d4_build <- function(tc, adu_d, prop_d) {
  g <- wc_groups(tc)
  map_dfr(grp_levels, function(gname) {
    ct <- g$CT20[g$grp == gname]
    a <- adu_d %>% filter(ct20 %in% ct); pr <- prop_d %>% filter(ct20 %in% ct)
    tibble(group = gname, tracts = length(ct), units = sum(a$units),
           completed = sum(a$units[a$status == "Completed"]), in_progress = sum(a$units[a$status == "In progress"]),
           stalled = sum(a$units[a$status == "Stalled"]),
           eligA = sum(pr$eligA), eligB = sum(pr$eligB), sf = sum(pr$is_sf),
           properties = n_distinct(a$prop_id))
  }) %>%
    mutate(per100A = 100 * units / eligA, per100B = 100 * units / eligB, per100sf = 100 * units / sf,
           share_completed = completed / units)
}
d4_table <- function(d4) {
  f <- function(x, d = 0) ifelse(is.finite(x), fmt(x, d), "n/a")
  p <- function(x) ifelse(is.finite(x), pct(x), "n/a")
  tibble(Measure = c("Census tracts", "ADU units", "Completed", "In progress", "Stalled",
                     "ADU units per 100 eligible lots, tier A", "ADU units per 100 eligible lots, tier B",
                     "ADU units per 100 single-family lots", "Properties with ADUs", "Share of units completed")) %>%
    bind_cols(map_dfc(seq_len(nrow(d4)), function(i) {
      r <- d4[i, ]
      v <- if (r$tracts == 0) rep("no tracts", 10) else
        c(fmt(r$tracts), fmt(r$units), fmt(r$completed), fmt(r$in_progress), fmt(r$stalled),
          f(r$per100A, 1), f(r$per100B, 1), f(r$per100sf, 1), fmt(r$properties), p(r$share_completed))
      setNames(tibble(v), r$group)
    }))
}
# ---- Tract map data: one color scale per measure, shared
# by all six CPAs; grey where the group has under 50 households or the rate is
# flagged low reliability.
rate_cols <- function(num_v, den_v, nm) {
  w <- acs_long %>% filter(variable %in% c(num_v, den_v)) %>%
    select(GEOID, variable, estimate, moe) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = c(estimate, moe))
  ne <- w[[paste0("estimate_", num_v)]]; de <- w[[paste0("estimate_", den_v)]]
  nm_ <- w[[paste0("moe_", num_v)]]; dm <- w[[paste0("moe_", den_v)]]
  est <- ifelse(de > 0, ne / de, NA_real_)
  mo <- ifelse(de > 0, moe_prop(ne, de, nm_, dm), NA_real_)
  cv <- (mo / 1.645) / est
  out <- tibble(GEOID = w$GEOID, num = ne, den = de, est = est, moe = mo,
                grey = is.na(est) | de < 50 | (is.finite(cv) & cv > 0.30) | (est == 0 & de < 50))
  names(out)[-1] <- paste0(nm, "_", names(out)[-1])
  out
}
d2_tract <- rate_cols("B25038_002", "B25038_001", "own") %>%
  left_join(rate_cols("B25003B_002", "B25003B_001", "blk"), by = "GEOID") %>%
  left_join(rate_cols("B25003I_002", "B25003I_001", "lat"), by = "GEOID") %>%
  left_join(tract_class %>% select(GEOID, class_lab = class, borderline, share_no_ba, moe_ba, share_occ, moe_occ,
                                   mfi, mfi_ratio, test_A, test_B, test_C, estimate_pop), by = "GEOID")
d2_domain <- map(c(own = "own", blk = "blk", lat = "lat"), function(v) {
  x <- d2_tract[[paste0(v, "_est")]][!d2_tract[[paste0(v, "_grey")]]]
  range(x, na.rm = TRUE)
})
d2_pal <- map(d2_domain, function(r) colorNumeric("YlGnBu", domain = r, na.color = "#D9D9D9"))

# ---- Layered tract map (homeowners and ADUs): shared pieces ----------------------
# "High" is fixed at 50% or more. Count scales are shared by all six CPAs, like the
# rate scales above, so a color means the same number in every CPA section.
lay_high <- 0.5
lay_cnt_max <- c(lat = max(d2_tract$lat_num, na.rm = TRUE), blk = max(d2_tract$blk_num, na.rm = TRUE))
lay_cnt_pal <- map(lay_cnt_max, function(mx) colorNumeric("Oranges", domain = c(0, mx), na.color = "#D9D9D9"))
hh_levels <- c("Both 50% or more", "Overall only", "Group only", "Neither", "Too few households or low reliability")
hh_cols <- setNames(c("#1B7837", "#A6DBA0", "#C2A5CF", "#F1EEF6", "#D9D9D9"), hh_levels)
lay_sw <- function(col, lab) sprintf('<div><span style="display:inline-block;width:14px;height:14px;background:%s;border:1px solid #999;margin-right:6px;vertical-align:middle;"></span>%s</div>', col, lab)
lay_ramp <- function(pal, vals, labs, title) paste0("<b>", title, "</b>", paste(lay_sw(pal(vals), labs), collapse = ""))
lay_rate_leg <- function(var, title, grey = TRUE) {
  dom <- d2_domain[[var]]; brk <- c(0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8); brk <- brk[brk >= dom[1] & brk <= dom[2]]
  paste0(lay_ramp(d2_pal[[var]], brk, paste0(round(100 * brk), "%"), title),
         if (grey) lay_sw("#D9D9D9", "Under 50 households or unreliable") else "")
}
lay_cnt_leg <- function(var, title) {
  v <- round(lay_cnt_max[[var]] * c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1), -1)
  lay_ramp(lay_cnt_pal[[var]], v, fmt(v), title)
}
lay_hi_leg <- function(g) paste0("<b>Homeownership and ", g, " homeownership</b><br><span style='font-size:11px'>Each rate is 50% or more, or not</span>",
                                 paste(lay_sw(hh_cols, sub("Group", g, names(hh_cols))), collapse = ""))
lay_legends <- list(
  latn = lay_cnt_leg("lat", "Latino owner households"), blkn = lay_cnt_leg("blk", "Black owner households"),
  own = lay_rate_leg("own", "Homeownership rate", grey = FALSE), lat = lay_rate_leg("lat", "Latino homeownership rate"),
  blk = lay_rate_leg("blk", "Black homeownership rate"),
  hil = lay_hi_leg("Latino"), hib = lay_hi_leg("Black"),
  wc = paste0("<b>Tract class</b>", paste(lay_sw(wc_cols, names(wc_cols)), collapse = "")), none = "")
lay_js <- "
  function(el, x, data) {
    var map = this;
    var layers = [['latn', 'Latino owner households (count)'], ['blkn', 'Black owner households (count)'],
                  ['own', 'Homeownership rate'], ['lat', 'Latino homeownership rate'], ['blk', 'Black homeownership rate'],
                  ['hil', 'Overall and Latino homeownership 50%+'], ['hib', 'Overall and Black homeownership 50%+'],
                  ['wc', 'Working-class tracts'], ['none', 'No shading (outlines only)']];
    var ctrl = L.control({position: 'topright'});
    ctrl.onAdd = function() {
      var div = L.DomUtil.create('div', 'leaflet-bar');
      div.style.background = 'white'; div.style.padding = '6px 8px'; div.style.fontSize = '12px'; div.style.maxWidth = '270px';
      var h = '<b>Shade tracts by</b><br><select class=\"ly\" style=\"max-width:100%\">';
      layers.forEach(function(l) { h += '<option value=\"' + l[0] + '\">' + l[1] + '</option>'; });
      h += '</select>';
      div.innerHTML = h; L.DomEvent.disableClickPropagation(div); L.DomEvent.disableScrollPropagation(div);
      return div;
    };
    ctrl.addTo(map);
    var leg = L.control({position: 'bottomright'});
    leg.onAdd = function() { var d = L.DomUtil.create('div', 'info legend'); d.style.background = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.92)'; d.style.padding = '6px 8px'; d.style.fontSize = '12px'; d.style.lineHeight = '18px'; return d; };
    leg.addTo(map);
    function update() {
      var ly = el.querySelector('select.ly').value;
      var c = data.cols[ly];
      Object.keys(c).forEach(function(id) { var l = map.layerManager.getLayer('shape', id); if (l) l.setStyle({fillColor: c[id], fillOpacity: ly === 'none' ? 0.02 : 0.72}); });
      leg.getContainer().innerHTML = data.legends[ly]; leg.getContainer().style.display = data.legends[ly] ? '' : 'none';
    }
    el.querySelector('select.ly').addEventListener('change', update);
    update();
  }"

store <- list()   # per-CPA results reused by the selection section
```

```{r stage7-earlier-run, include=FALSE}
# Benchmarks for the CPA outputs
a1_exp <- tribble(~cpa, ~c, ~i, ~s,
  "Arleta - Pacoima", 1502, 327, 180, "West Adams - Baldwin Hills - Leimert", 2077, 644, 251,
  "South Los Angeles", 2308, 820, 312, "Southeast Los Angeles", 1460, 650, 173,
  "Northeast Los Angeles", 2137, 677, 218, "Boyle Heights", 326, 135, 38)
old_by_text <- old_out %>% group_by(cpa) %>%
  summarise(c = sum(units[status == "Completed"]), i = sum(units[status == "In progress"]), s = sum(units[status == "Stalled"]))
for (k in seq_len(nrow(a1_exp))) {
  e <- a1_exp[k, ]; d <- adu %>% filter(cpa_text == e$cpa)
  o <- c(sum(d$units[d$status == "Completed"]), sum(d$units[d$status == "In progress"]), sum(d$units[d$status == "Stalled"]))
  ob <- old_by_text[old_by_text$cpa == e$cpa, ]
  cut_u <- sum(d$units[!d$completed & d$last_activity %in% stall_cutoff])
  cons <- nrow(ob) == 1 && o[1] == ob$c && o[3] == ob$s + cut_u && o[2] == ob$i - cut_u
  qa_add(7, paste0("Earlier run: ADU units by status, by permit CPA text (completed / in progress / stalled), ", e$cpa),
         paste(fmt(c(e$c, e$i, e$s)), collapse = " / "), paste(fmt(o), collapse = " / "), all(o == c(e$c, e$i, e$s)),
         reason = if (cons) sprintf("The target came from an earlier test computation; completed units equal the earlier R output (%s), and the <= cutoff moves %d unit(s) to stalled.", fmt(ob$c), cut_u) else NA_character_)
}
tier_exp <- tribble(~cpa, ~oa, ~ob, ~sf, ~mf,
  "Arleta - Pacoima", 26, 26, 1897, 73, "West Adams - Baldwin Hills - Leimert", 93, 133, 1954, 956,
  "South Los Angeles", 177, 177, 1927, 1351, "Southeast Los Angeles", 177, 177, 1162, 970,
  "Northeast Los Angeles", 186, 186, 2084, 794, "Boyle Heights", 37, 37, 209, 260)
for (k in seq_len(nrow(tier_exp))) {
  e <- tier_exp[k, ]; d <- adu %>% filter(cpa == e$cpa); dA <- d %>% filter(join_step == "1. APN")
  o <- c(sum(d$units[d$outside_A_sf]), sum(d$units[d$outside_B_sf])); oA <- c(sum(dA$units[dA$outside_A_sf]), sum(dA$units[dA$outside_B_sf]))
  qa_add(7, paste0("Earlier run: ADU units outside tier A / tier B, single-family lots only, ", e$cpa), paste(fmt(c(e$oa, e$ob)), collapse = " / "),
         paste(fmt(o), collapse = " / "), all(o == c(e$oa, e$ob)),
         reason = if (all(oA == c(e$oa, e$ob))) "The target used the APN step only; restricted to APN-matched projects this build reproduces it. The PIN and coordinate steps add the rest." else NA_character_)
  t <- c(sum(d$units[d$property_type == "Single-family"]), sum(d$units[d$property_type == "Multi-family"]))
  tA <- c(sum(dA$units[dA$property_type == "Single-family"]), sum(dA$units[dA$property_type == "Multi-family"]))
  qa_add(7, paste0("Earlier run: ADU units on single-family / multi-family properties, ", e$cpa), paste(fmt(c(e$sf, e$mf)), collapse = " / "),
         paste(fmt(t), collapse = " / "), all(t == c(e$sf, e$mf)),
         reason = if (all(tA == c(e$sf, e$mf))) "The target used the APN step only; restricted to APN-matched projects this build reproduces it. The PIN and coordinate steps add the rest." else NA_character_)
}
```
